      """Trait-like event colors: policies, GCal rendering, provider wiring."""
      from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
      from datetime import date, timedelta
      from types import SimpleNamespace
      
      from dir3 import cli
      from dir3.color import (
          GREEN_SLOT,
          ORANGE_SLOT,
          RED_SLOT,
          YELLOW_SLOT,
          ColorPolicy,
          DictColorPolicy,
          PlainPolicy,
          PrayerColorPolicy,
          PrayerStatusColorPolicy,
          name_slot,
          normalize_event_name,
          to_gcal_color_id,
      )
      from dir3.config import Dir3Config, LocationSettings, PrayerSettings
      from dir3.core import day, task, week
      from dir3.engine import compile_pattern
      from dir3.services import Services
      from dir3.services.gcal import (
          GCalSyncReport,
          GoogleCalendar,
          GoogleCalendarSyncer,
      )
      
      ISTANBUL = LocationSettings(latitude=40.7992, longitude=29.4305, timezone="Europe/Istanbul")
      
      
      def _coding_day():
          @day
          def coding(ctx):
              return [
                  task("Fajr", start=ctx.prayer.fajr, until=ctx.prayer.sunrise),
                  task("Coding", duration=timedelta(hours=2)),
                  task("Reading", duration=timedelta(hours=1)),
              ]
      
          return coding
      
      
      def _one_day_plan():
          config = Dir3Config(location=ISTANBUL, prayer=PrayerSettings(provider="offline"))
          coding = _coding_day()
          return compile_pattern(
              week(mon=coding, tue=coding, wed=coding, thu=coding, fri=coding, sat=coding, sun=coding),
              days=1,
              start_date=date(2026, 9, 14),
              services=Services(config=config),
          )
      
      
      def _syncer(**kwargs):
          settings = GoogleCalendar(client_id="c", client_secret="s", refresh_token="r")
          return GoogleCalendarSyncer(settings, **kwargs)
      
      
      def test_prayers_always_yellow():
          from dir3.color import YELLOW_SLOT
      
          policy = PrayerColorPolicy()
          for name in ("Fajr", "FAJR", "  dhuhr  ", "Duhr", "Asr", "Maghrib", "Isha", "Sunrise"):
              assert policy.color_for(name, 0) == YELLOW_SLOT
              assert policy.color_for(name, 7) == YELLOW_SLOT
          assert to_gcal_color_id(YELLOW_SLOT) == "5"  # Banana
      
      
      def test_prayer_status_policy_colors_shifted_critical_and_lecture_overlap():
          policy = PrayerStatusColorPolicy()
          assert policy.color_for("Dhuhr", 0) == GREEN_SLOT
          assert policy.color_for("Asr (verschoben: Adhan 14:14 → 15:50)", 0) == YELLOW_SLOT
          assert policy.color_for("Maghrib (kritisch, noch 22 min bis Isha-Adhan)", 0) == RED_SLOT
          assert (
              policy.color_for("Asr (Kerahat, noch 42 min bis Maghrib-Adhan)", 0)
              == RED_SLOT
          )
          assert policy.color_for("Maghrib (11 min von der Vorlesung)", 0) == ORANGE_SLOT
          assert (
              policy.color_for("Jumuah (verschoben: Adhan 11:51 → 12:30)", 0)
              == YELLOW_SLOT
          )
          assert (
              policy.color_for("Maghrib (verschoben, 11 min von der Vorlesung)", 0)
              == ORANGE_SLOT
          )
          assert (
              policy.color_for(
                  "Maghrib (verschoben, kritisch, noch 20 min bis Isha-Adhan, "
                  "11 min von der Vorlesung)",
                  0,
              )
              == RED_SLOT
          )
          assert to_gcal_color_id(ORANGE_SLOT) == "6"  # Tangerine
          assert to_gcal_color_id(GREEN_SLOT) == "2"  # Sage
          assert to_gcal_color_id(RED_SLOT) == "11"  # Tomato
          assert policy.color_for("Asr Analysis", 0) == name_slot("asr analysis")
          assert policy.color_for("Coding", 0) == name_slot("coding")
      
      
      def test_name_hash_deterministic_per_name():
          from dir3.color import name_slot
      
          policy = PrayerColorPolicy()
          # sum(b"coding") = 628 -> 628 % 11 = 1, independent of position
          assert name_slot("Coding") == 1
          assert policy.color_for("Coding", 0) == 1
          assert policy.color_for("Coding", 9) == 1
          assert policy.color_for("coding", 4) == 1  # case-insensitive
          # sum(b"reading") = 730 -> 730 % 11 = 4
          assert name_slot("Reading") == 4
          assert policy.color_for("Reading", 0) == 4
      
      
      def test_plain_policy_disables_colors():
          assert PlainPolicy().color_for("Fajr", 0) is None
          assert PlainPolicy().color_for("Coding", 3) is None
      
      
      def test_to_gcal_color_id_palette_and_bounds():
          assert to_gcal_color_id(0) == "3"  # Fajr -> grape
          assert to_gcal_color_id(4) == "11"  # Maghrib -> tomato
          assert to_gcal_color_id(5) == "9"  # Isha -> blueberry
          assert to_gcal_color_id(11) is None
          assert to_gcal_color_id(-1) is None
          assert to_gcal_color_id("xx") is None
          assert to_gcal_color_id(True) is None
      
      
      def test_normalize_event_name():
          assert normalize_event_name("  Fajr ") == "fajr"
          assert normalize_event_name(None) == ""
      
      
      def test_dict_policy_overrides_and_falls_back():
          policy = DictColorPolicy({"Coding": 9, "fajr": "11"}, fallback=PrayerColorPolicy())
          assert to_gcal_color_id(policy.color_for("Coding", 0)) == "9"  # round-trip
          assert to_gcal_color_id(policy.color_for("coding", 5)) == "9"  # case-insensitive
          assert to_gcal_color_id(policy.color_for("Fajr", 0)) == "11"  # round-trip
          assert policy.color_for("Dhuhr", 0) == 2  # prayer yellow fallback
          assert policy.color_for("Reading", 4) == 4  # name-hashed fallback
      
      
      def test_dict_policy_ignores_invalid_values():
          from dir3.color import name_slot
      
          policy = DictColorPolicy({"A": 99, "B": "xx", "C": True, "D": 0})
          # invalid overrides dropped -> name-hashed fallback (a->9, b->10, c->0, d->1)
          assert policy.color_for("A", 1) == name_slot("a") == 9
          assert policy.color_for("B", 1) == name_slot("b") == 10
          assert policy.color_for("C", 1) == name_slot("c") == 0
          assert policy.color_for("D", 1) == name_slot("d") == 1
      
      
      def test_custom_trait_impl_needs_no_inheritance():
          class SleepBlue:
              def color_for(self, name, index):
                  return 9 if "sleep" in name.lower() else None
      
          assert isinstance(SleepBlue(), ColorPolicy)
          assert SleepBlue().color_for("Sleep", 0) == 9
          assert SleepBlue().color_for("Work", 0) is None
      
      
      def test_stage_applies_policy_colors():
          staged = _syncer().stage(_one_day_plan(), timezone_name="Europe/Istanbul")
          by_name = {e.summary: e for e in staged}
          assert by_name["Fajr"].body["colorId"] == "5"  # yellow
          assert by_name["Coding"].body["colorId"] == "6"  # hashed slot 1
          assert by_name["Reading"].body["colorId"] == "11"  # hashed slot 4
      
      
      def test_stage_dict_override_wins():
          syncer = _syncer(color_policy=DictColorPolicy({"Coding": 11}))
          by_name = {
              e.summary: e for e in syncer.stage(_one_day_plan(), timezone_name="Europe/Istanbul")
          }
          assert by_name["Coding"].body["colorId"] == "11"
          assert by_name["Fajr"].body["colorId"] == "5"  # yellow fallback intact
      
      
      def test_stage_plain_policy_omits_color_id():
          staged = _syncer(color_policy=PlainPolicy()).stage(
              _one_day_plan(), timezone_name="Europe/Istanbul"
          )
          assert all("colorId" not in e.body for e in staged)
      
      
      def test_config_overlay_merges_colors():
          config = Dir3Config()
          config.overlay(SimpleNamespace(colors={"Coding": 9}))
          config.overlay(SimpleNamespace(colors={"Reading": "5"}))
          assert config.colors == {"Coding": 9, "Reading": "5"}
          config.overlay(SimpleNamespace())
          assert config.colors == {"Coding": 9, "Reading": "5"}
      
      
      def test_config_overlay_accepts_color_policy():
          policy = PrayerStatusColorPolicy()
          config = Dir3Config()
          config.overlay(SimpleNamespace(color_policy=policy))
          assert config.color_policy is policy
          config.overlay(SimpleNamespace(color_policy=object()))
          assert config.color_policy is policy
      
      
      def test_cli_passes_colors_to_syncer(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
          planfile = tmp_path / "plan.py"
          planfile.write_text(

      def test_sync_bodies_carry_color_id():
          import asyncio

              async def discover(self, *args, **kwargs):

                  responses = [_Status() for _ in requests]
                  return responses if len(responses) > 1 else responses[0]
      
          @asynccontextmanager
          async def open_client(settings, timeout):
              yield _FakeAg(), _FakeCal()
      
          syncer = _syncer(client_factory=open_client)
          asyncio.run(syncer.sync(_one_day_plan(), timezone_name="Europe/Istanbul"))

      """Plan-specific rules: 1h45 lectures, prayer modes, breaks, Sunday rules."""
      
      from datetime import date, time, timedelta
      from types import SimpleNamespace
      from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
      
      import gebetsplan
      from dir3.color import to_gcal_color_id
      
      
      def _by_name(slots):
          return {title.split(" ")[0]: (title, start, end) for title, start, end in slots}
      
      
      def test_robs_exercise_is_on_thursday_morning():
          thursday = gebetsplan._display_lectures(date(2026, 11, 5))
          assert ("10:00", "11:45", "EN 732 ROBS (Uebung, Marvin)") in thursday
          official = gebetsplan._lectures_for(date(2026, 11, 5))
          assert ("10:00", "12:00", "EN 732 ROBS (Uebung, Marvin)") in official
          tuesday = gebetsplan._lectures_for(date(2026, 11, 3))
          assert all("ROBS" not in label for _, _, label in tuesday)
      
      
      def test_lectures_are_1h45_and_keep_official_block_for_overlap():
          monday = gebetsplan._lectures_for(date(2026, 11, 2))
          assert ("14:00", "16:00", "HE101 AnalinA (Winkert)") in monday
          display = gebetsplan._display_lectures(date(2026, 11, 2))
          assert ("14:00", "15:45", "HE101 AnalinA (Winkert)") in display
          assert ("16:00", "17:45", "A053 ROBS") in display
      
      
      def test_prayer_durations_use_hanafi_rakats_and_wudu():
          assert gebetsplan.WUDU == 3
          assert gebetsplan._dur("Fajr") == 3 + 4 * 2
          assert gebetsplan._dur("Dhuhr") == 3 + 10 * 2
          assert gebetsplan._dur("Isha") == 3 + 13 * 2
          assert gebetsplan._prayer_duration("Fajr", mosque=True) == 10 + 3 + 4 * 2
          assert gebetsplan._prayer_duration("Isha", fardh=True) == 3 + 4 * 2
          assert gebetsplan._prayer_duration("Dhuhr", mosque=True, fardh=True) == 10 + 3 + 4 * 2
      
      
      def test_lecture_overlap_ignores_first_quarter_hour():
          lectures = [("10:00", "12:00", "Test")]
          assert gebetsplan._lecture_taken(9 * 60 + 55, 10 * 60 + 9, lectures) == 0
          assert gebetsplan._lecture_taken(10 * 60 + 5, 10 * 60 + 18, lectures) == 3
          assert gebetsplan._lecture_taken(10 * 60 + 20, 10 * 60 + 33, lectures) == 13
          assert gebetsplan._lecture_taken(11 * 60 + 50, 12 * 60 + 3, lectures) == 0
      
      
      def test_slot_titles_mark_shift_critical_and_overlap():
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title("Asr", 14 * 60 + 14, 15 * 60 + 45, 15 * 60 + 53, 16 * 60 + 44, 0)
              == "Asr (verschoben: Adhan 14:14 → 15:48)"
          )
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title("Asr", 14 * 60 + 14, 14 * 60 + 30, 14 * 60 + 43, 16 * 60 + 44, 15)
              == "Asr (verschoben: Adhan 14:14 → 14:33, 15 min von der Vorlesung)"
          )
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title("Maghrib", 17 * 60 + 50, 17 * 60 + 45, 17 * 60 + 51, 18 * 60 + 5, 0)
              == "Maghrib (verschoben, kritisch, noch 14 min bis Isha-Adhan)"
          )
          assert gebetsplan._slot_title(
              "Maghrib", 16 * 60 + 40, 16 * 60 + 45, 16 * 60 + 56, 17 * 60 + 10, 8
          ) == ("Maghrib (verschoben, kritisch, noch 14 min bis Isha-Adhan, 8 min von der Vorlesung)")
          assert gebetsplan._slot_title(
              "Maghrib", 16 * 60 + 40, 16 * 60 + 45, 16 * 60 + 56, 16 * 60 + 50, 8
          ) == ("Maghrib (verschoben, kritisch, nur 2 min bis Isha-Adhan, 8 min von der Vorlesung)")
      
      
      def test_slot_titles_mark_mosque_alone_fardh_and_breaks():
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title(
                  "Fajr",
                  5 * 60,
                  4 * 60 + 47,
                  5 * 60 + 8,
                  7 * 60,
                  0,
                  prayer_start=5 * 60,
                  mode="mosque",
              )
              == "Fajr (Moschee)"
          )
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title(
                  "Isha",
                  18 * 60,
                  17 * 60 + 47,
                  18 * 60 + 13,
                  24 * 60,
                  0,
                  prayer_start=18 * 60,
                  mode="nearby",
                  fardh=True,
              )
              == "Isha (allein, nur Fardh)"
          )
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title(
                  "Maghrib",
                  16 * 60 + 25,
                  16 * 60 + 22,
                  16 * 60 + 35,
                  18 * 60,
                  0,
                  broken=("A053 ROBS",),
                  prayer_start=16 * 60 + 25,
                  mode="nearby",
              )
              == "Maghrib (!! bricht A053 ROBS ab, anders nicht möglich, allein)"
          )
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title(
                  "Isha",
                  18 * 60,
                  18 * 60,
                  18 * 60 + 8,
                  18 * 60 + 20,
                  0,
                  impossible=True,
                  prayer_start=18 * 60,
                  mode="nearby",
                  fardh=True,
              )
              == "Isha (!! anders nicht möglich, allein, nur Fardh, kritisch, "
              "noch 12 min bis Fajr-Adhan)"
          )
      
      
      def test_gebeteslots_choose_mosque_fardh_and_break_when_needed():
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 24),
              sunrise=time(7, 16),
              dhuhr=time(11, 56),
              asr=time(14, 1),
              maghrib=time(16, 25),
              isha=time(18, 10),
          )
          slots, breaks = gebetsplan._gebeteslots_with_breaks(sched, date(2026, 11, 12))
          by_name = _by_name(slots)
      
          assert by_name["Dhuhr"] == (
              "Dhuhr (Moschee, nur Fardh, verschoben: Adhan 11:56 → 11:58)",
              11 * 60 + 45,
              12 * 60 + 6,
          )
          assert by_name["Asr"] == (
              "Asr (Moschee)",
              13 * 60 + 48,
              14 * 60 + 17,
          )
          assert by_name["Maghrib"] == (
              "Maghrib (!! bricht HE101 AnalinA (Uebung) ab, anders nicht möglich, allein)",
              16 * 60 + 22,
              16 * 60 + 35,
          )
          assert breaks == [(16 * 60 + 22, 16 * 60 + 35, "HE101 AnalinA (Uebung)")]
      
      
      def test_gebeteslots_choose_alone_when_mosque_travel_is_tight():
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 0),
              sunrise=time(7, 0),
              dhuhr=time(12, 0),
              asr=time(14, 20),
              maghrib=time(16, 42),
              isha=time(18, 25),
          )
          slots = gebetsplan._gebeteslots(sched, date(2026, 11, 2))
          by_name = _by_name(slots)
      
          assert by_name["Maghrib"] == (
              "Maghrib (allein, verschoben: Adhan 16:42 → 17:48)",
              17 * 60 + 45,
              17 * 60 + 58,
          )
      
      
      def test_candidate_enforces_last_30_minutes_rule():
          assert (
              gebetsplan._candidate(
                  "Fajr",
                  16 * 60,
                  16 * 60 + 30,
                  [],
                  [],
                  mosque=False,
                  fardh=True,
                  natural=False,
              )
              is not None
          )
          assert (
              gebetsplan._candidate(
                  "Fajr",
                  16 * 60,
                  16 * 60 + 29,
                  [],
                  [],
                  mosque=False,
                  fardh=True,
                  natural=False,
              )
              is None
          )
      
      
      def test_asr_kerahat_forces_fardh():
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 0),
              sunrise=time(7, 0),
              dhuhr=time(12, 0),
              asr=time(16, 10),
              maghrib=time(17, 0),
              isha=time(18, 30),
          )
          slots = gebetsplan._gebeteslots(sched, date(2026, 11, 7))
          by_name = _by_name(slots)
      
          assert by_name["Asr"] == (
              "Asr (Moschee, nur Fardh, Kerahat, noch 42 min bis Maghrib-Adhan)",
              15 * 60 + 57,
              16 * 60 + 18,
          )
      
      
      def test_studienplan_splits_lecture_at_broken_prayer():
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 24),
              sunrise=time(7, 16),
              dhuhr=time(11, 56),
              asr=time(14, 1),
              maghrib=time(16, 25),
              isha=time(18, 10),
          )
          ctx = SimpleNamespace(
              plan_date=date(2026, 11, 12),
              location=SimpleNamespace(tzinfo=ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")),
              prayer=SimpleNamespace(schedule=lambda ctx: sched),
          )
          tasks = gebetsplan._studienplan(ctx)
          lecture_parts = [
              (task.start, task.until) for task in tasks if task.name == "HE101 AnalinA (Uebung)"
          ]
          assert lecture_parts == [(time(16, 0), time(16, 22)), (time(16, 35), time(17, 45))]
          maghrib = next(task for task in tasks if task.name.startswith("Maghrib"))
          assert (maghrib.start, maghrib.duration) == (
              time(16, 22),
              timedelta(minutes=13),
          )
      
      
      def test_jumuah_time_switches_with_daylight_saving():
          tz = ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")
          assert gebetsplan._jumuah_start(date(2026, 11, 6), tz) == 12 * 60 + 30
          assert gebetsplan._jumuah_start(date(2026, 7, 3), tz) == 13 * 60 + 30
      
      
      def test_friday_uses_jumuah_travel_and_skips_regular_dhuhr():
          tz = ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 30),
              sunrise=time(7, 20),
              dhuhr=time(11, 50),
              asr=time(14, 0),
              maghrib=time(16, 30),
              isha=time(18, 10),
          )
          ctx = SimpleNamespace(
              plan_date=date(2026, 11, 6),
              location=SimpleNamespace(tzinfo=tz),
              prayer=SimpleNamespace(schedule=lambda ctx: sched),
          )
      
          tasks = gebetsplan._studienplan(ctx)
          by_name = {task.name: task for task in tasks}
          assert "Dhuhr" not in by_name
          travel = by_name["Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin, Galenstr. BUS 136"]
          assert travel.start == time(11, 45)
          assert travel.duration == timedelta(minutes=45)
          jumuah = by_name["Jumuah (verschoben: Adhan 11:50 → 12:30)"]
          assert jumuah.start == time(12, 30)
          assert jumuah.duration == timedelta(minutes=60)
      
      
      def test_friday_asr_does_not_overlap_jumuah():
          tz = ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 30),
              sunrise=time(7, 20),
              dhuhr=time(12, 5),
              asr=time(13, 41),
              maghrib=time(15, 46),
              isha=time(17, 52),
          )
          ctx = SimpleNamespace(
              plan_date=date(2026, 12, 11),
              location=SimpleNamespace(tzinfo=tz),
              prayer=SimpleNamespace(schedule=lambda ctx: sched),
          )
      
          tasks = gebetsplan._studienplan(ctx)
          jumuah = next(task for task in tasks if task.name.startswith("Jumuah"))
          asr = next(task for task in tasks if task.name.startswith("Asr"))
          assert (jumuah.start, jumuah.duration) == (
              time(12, 30),
              timedelta(minutes=60),
          )
          assert asr.start == time(13, 30)
          assert asr.name == "Asr (Moschee, verschoben: Adhan 13:41 → 13:43)"
      
      
      def test_friday_jumuah_moves_late_in_summer():
          tz = ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(2, 45),
              sunrise=time(4, 45),
              dhuhr=time(13, 10),
              asr=time(17, 30),
              maghrib=time(21, 30),
              isha=time(23, 15),
          )
          ctx = SimpleNamespace(
              plan_date=date(2026, 7, 3),
              location=SimpleNamespace(tzinfo=tz),
              prayer=SimpleNamespace(schedule=lambda ctx: sched),
          )
      
          tasks = {task.name: task for task in gebetsplan._studienplan(ctx)}
          travel = tasks["Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin, Galenstr. BUS 136"]
          assert travel.start == time(12, 45)
          jumuah = tasks["Jumuah (verschoben: Adhan 13:10 → 13:30)"]
          assert jumuah.start == time(13, 30)
      
      
      def test_going_couples_way_before_event():
          event = gebetsplan.task("Netzwerken", start=time(18, 0), until=time(22, 0), flex=False)
          way = gebetsplan.task("Weg", duration=timedelta(minutes=45), flex=False)
      
          tasks = gebetsplan.going(event, way)
      
          assert [task.name for task in tasks] == ["Weg", "Netzwerken"]
          assert tasks[0].start == time(17, 15)
          assert tasks[0].duration == timedelta(minutes=45)
          assert tasks[1] is event
      
      
      def test_asr_kerahat_title():
          kerahat = gebetsplan._slot_title(
              "Asr",
              14 * 60,
              13 * 60 + 57,
              14 * 60 + 8,
              14 * 60 + 50,
              0,
              prayer_start=14 * 60,
          )
          assert kerahat == "Asr (Kerahat, noch 42 min bis Maghrib-Adhan)"
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title(
                  "Asr",
                  14 * 60,
                  13 * 60 + 57,
                  14 * 60 + 8,
                  15 * 60,
                  0,
                  prayer_start=14 * 60,
              )
              == "Asr"
          )
      
      
      def test_sunday_isha_is_fixed_at_1830_when_adhan_is_earlier():
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 0),
              sunrise=time(7, 0),
              dhuhr=time(12, 0),
              asr=time(14, 0),
              maghrib=time(16, 30),
              isha=time(18, 10),
          )
          slots = gebetsplan._gebeteslots(sched, date(2026, 11, 1))
          by_name = _by_name(slots)
      
          assert by_name["Isha"] == (
              "Isha (Moschee, verschoben: Adhan 18:10 → 18:30)",
              18 * 60 + 17,
              18 * 60 + 56,
          )
      
      
      def test_sunday_isha_uses_late_adhan_without_shifting():
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 0),
              sunrise=time(7, 0),
              dhuhr=time(12, 0),
              asr=time(14, 0),
              maghrib=time(16, 34),
              isha=time(18, 34),
          )
          slots = gebetsplan._gebeteslots(sched, date(2026, 10, 25))
          by_name = _by_name(slots)
      
          assert by_name["Isha"] == (
              "Isha (Moschee)",
              18 * 60 + 21,
              19 * 60,
          )
      
      
      def test_other_days_keep_isha_at_adhan():
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 0),
              sunrise=time(7, 0),
              dhuhr=time(12, 0),
              asr=time(14, 0),
              maghrib=time(16, 30),
              isha=time(18, 10),
          )
          slots = gebetsplan._gebeteslots(sched, date(2026, 11, 7))
          by_name = _by_name(slots)
      
          assert by_name["Isha"] == ("Isha (Moschee)", 17 * 60 + 57, 18 * 60 + 36)
      
      
      def test_sunday_netzwerken_is_split_around_isha():
          tz = ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 0),
              sunrise=time(7, 0),
              dhuhr=time(12, 0),
              asr=time(14, 0),
              maghrib=time(16, 30),
              isha=time(18, 10),
          )
          ctx = SimpleNamespace(
              plan_date=date(2026, 11, 1),
              location=SimpleNamespace(tzinfo=tz),
              prayer=SimpleNamespace(schedule=lambda ctx: sched),
          )
      
          tasks = gebetsplan._studienplan(ctx)
          way = next(
              task for task in tasks if task.name == "Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin, Galenstr. BUS 136"
          )
          assert (way.start, way.duration) == (time(17, 15), timedelta(minutes=45))
          netzwerken = [(task.start, task.until) for task in tasks if task.name == "Netzwerken"]
          assert netzwerken == [
              (time(18, 0), time(18, 17)),
              (time(18, 56), time(22, 0)),
          ]
          isha = next(task for task in tasks if task.name.startswith("Isha"))
          assert (isha.start, isha.duration) == (
              time(18, 17),
              timedelta(minutes=39),
          )
      
      
      def test_color_policy_prayers_basil_and_module_groups():
          policy = gebetsplan.color_policy
          for name in (
              "Fajr",
              "Dhuhr (Moschee, nur Fardh)",
              "Asr (Kerahat)",
              "Jumuah (verschoben: Adhan 11:55 → 12:30)",
              "Isha (Moschee)",
              "Maghrib (!! bricht A053 ROBS ab, anders nicht möglich, allein)",
          ):
              assert to_gcal_color_id(policy.color_for(name, 0)) == "10"
      
          assert to_gcal_color_id(policy.color_for("Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin", 0)) == "8"
          assert to_gcal_color_id(policy.color_for("Netzwerken", 0)) == "6"
      
          module_colors = {
              "HE101 AnalinA (Winkert)": "7",
              "A053 ROBS": "11",
              "MA 751 IaD (Uebung)": "9",
              "E-N732 GldP (Uebung)": "3",
          }
          assert {
              name: to_gcal_color_id(policy.color_for(name, 0)) for name in module_colors
          } == module_colors
          assert len(set(module_colors.values())) == 4
          assert "10" not in module_colors.values()
      
          assert to_gcal_color_id(policy.color_for("x", 0)) == "1"

      """Gebets-Woche: jeder Tag um die fünf Gebete herum gebaut.
      
      Jeder Tag startet 5 Minuten vor dem Adhan mit dem Gebet, jede Rakat dauert
      2 Minuten. Dazu kommt taeglich eine Qaylulah (Mittagsruhe nach Dhuhr).
      
      Unter der Woche: 2h Lesen, 2h Coding, 1h Fruehstueck, 1h Dinner.
      Am Wochenende:  Rausgehen, Familie (mittags & abends), mehr Lesen (3h),
      mehr Coding (3h).
      
          dir3 examples/gebets_woche.py --until 7          # eine Woche
          dir3 examples/gebets_woche.py --until 360        # ein ganzes Jahr
      """
      
      from datetime import timedelta
      
      from dir3 import GoogleCalendar, day, next_event, prayer, task
      from dir3 import week as _week
      
      # --- Standort (dein Ort, hier im Planfile) ----------------------------------
      # lat, lon, IANA-Zeitzone. Ohne diese Zeile bestimmt dir3 ihn per Geolocation.
      location = (40.7992, 29.4305, "Europe/Istanbul")
      
      # --- Gebete: (Name, Adhan-Anker, Rakat-Zahl) --------------------------------
      # Start je 5 Minuten vor dem Adhan; jede Rakat dauert 2 Minuten.
      SALAWAT = [
          ("Fajr", prayer.fajr, 2),
          ("Dhuhr", prayer.dhuhr, 4),
          ("Asr", prayer.asr, 4),
          ("Maghrib", prayer.maghrib, 3),
          ("Isha", prayer.isha, 4),
      ]
      
      
      def _salawat():
          return [
              task(
                  name,
                  start=adhan - timedelta(minutes=5),
                  duration=timedelta(minutes=rakats * 2),
              )
              for name, adhan, rakats in SALAWAT
          ]
      
      
      @day(name="Gebets-Tag")
      def werktag(ctx):
          fajr, dhuhr, asr, maghrib, isha = _salawat()
          return [
              fajr,
              task("Lesen", duration=timedelta(hours=2), flex=True),
              task("Frühstück", duration=timedelta(hours=1), flex=True),
              task("Coding", duration=timedelta(hours=2), flex=True),
              dhuhr,
              task("Qaylulah", duration=timedelta(minutes=40)),
              asr,
              task("Dinner", duration=timedelta(hours=1), flex=True),
              maghrib,
              isha,
              task("Schlafen", until=next_event),
          ]
      
      
      @day(name="Familien-Tag")
      def familientag(ctx):
          fajr, dhuhr, asr, maghrib, isha = _salawat()
          return [
              fajr,
              task("Rausgehen", duration=timedelta(minutes=90)),
              task("Familienzeit", duration=timedelta(hours=2)),
              task("Lesen", duration=timedelta(hours=3), flex=True),
              dhuhr,
              task("Qaylulah", duration=timedelta(minutes=40)),
              asr,
              task(
                  "Coding",
                  until=prayer.maghrib - timedelta(minutes=5),
                  flex=True,
              ),
              maghrib,
              task("Familienzeit", duration=timedelta(hours=1), flex=True),
              isha,
              task("Schlafen", until=next_event),
          ]
      
      
      def make_plan():
          return _week(
              mon=werktag,
              tue=werktag,
              wed=werktag,
              thu=werktag,
              fri=werktag,
              sat=familientag,
              sun=familientag,
          )
      
      
      # --- Google Calendar (optional) ----------------------------------------------
      # Einmalig: dir3-gcal-setup --client-id … --client-secret …  (liefert das
      # Refresh-Token), dann diesen Block hierher einfügen und mit --sync-gcal laufen:
      #
      #   dir3 examples/gebets_woche.py --sync-gcal
      #
      # from dir3 import GoogleCalendar
      # gcal = GoogleCalendar(
      #     client_id="…",
      #     client_secret="…",
      #     refresh_token="…",
      #     calendar_id="primary",
      # )
      
      
      __title__ = "Gebets-Woche"
      
      gcal = GoogleCalendar(
          client_id='251032523871-1ltlu7p65v6614oo0uee2cs6usjj3gdn.apps.googleusercontent.com',
          client_secret='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',
          refresh_token='1//03Xih17XCE8Z3CgYIARAAGAMSNwF-L9Ir2Of6M1SKrA5a5VHaTP1at7CycCXCKeeD-lk97gHSmbQvIqAc6Bijr-b0J18I_UVbzZk',
          calendar_id="primary",
      )

      """Dein ganzes Jahr ist EINE Funktion.
      
      Das ist der rote Faden: statt dutzender Kalenderbausteine "programmierst du
      dein Leben" als eine einzige (date) -> Tag Funktion. Jeder Kalendereintrag ist
      ein Code-Zweig:
      
          * Schultage           nach Wochentag;
          * Wochenende          nach Wochentag;
          * Freie Tage          durch einen einfachen Set-Ueberlauf;
          * Pruefungen          an konkreten Daten -> erscheinen automatisch;
          * Feiertage/Geburtstage -> weiche, unvergessliche Bausteine.
      
      Alles ist Python. Willst du einen neuen Feiertag? Eine neue Prüfung?
      Einfach eine Zeile ändern - das ganze Jahr passt sich neu zusammen.
      """
      from datetime import date, time
      
      from dir3 import anchor, day, task
      from dir3 import calendar as _calendar
      
      # --- Standort (dein Ort, hier im Planfile) ----------------------------------
      # lat, lon, IANA-Zeitzone. Ohne diese Zeile bestimmt dir3 ihn per Geolocation.
      location = (40.7992, 29.4305, "Europe/Istanbul")
      
      # --- Kalender-Fakten (aus den deiner Welt) ----------------------------------
      FEIERTAGE = {
          date(2026, 12, 24): "Heiligabend",
          date(2026, 1, 1): "Neujahr",
          date(2026, 3, 20): "Tuerkischer Befreiungstag",
      }
      
      PRUEFUNGEN = {
          date(2026, 3, 12): "Zwischenklausur Analysis",
          date(2026, 7, 8): "Muedliche Pruefung",
          date(2026, 8, 25): "Nachpruefung Statistik",
      }
      
      GEBURTSTAGE = {
          date(2026, 9, 15): "Aylin",
          date(2026, 12, 2): "Mama",
      }
      
      FREIE_TAGE = {date(2026, 6, 29), date(2026, 9, 21)}
      
      PA_FREI = frozenset(date(2026, m, 1) for m in range(1, 13))  # 1. des Monats
      
      
      @anchor
      def morgen(ctx):
          return time(6, 30)
      
      
      @anchor
      def pausetastisch(ctx):
          return time(12, 30)
      
      
      @day(name="Schultag")
      def schul(ctx):
          return [
              task("Frühstück & Rucksack", start=morgen, duration="30m"),
              task("Schule", start=time(8, 0), until=time(13, 0), flex=True),
              task("Hausaufgaben", start=time(15, 0), duration="1h30m", flex=True),
              task("Freizeit/Familie", duration="2h", flex=True),
          ]
      
      
      @day(name="Pa-Tag")
      def freitag(ctx):
          return [
              task("Schule bis Mittag", start=time(8, 0), until=time(12, 0), flex=True),
              task("Freitagspause", start=pausetastisch, duration="2h"),
              task("Fragen an die Familie", start=time(15, 0), duration="1h"),
              task("Abend & Familie", duration="3h", flex=True),
          ]
      
      
      @day(name="Wochenende")
      def wochenende(ctx):
          return [
              task("Ausschlafen", start=time(9, 0), duration="2h"),
              task("Familienzeit", start=time(11, 0), duration="3h", flex=True),
              task("Freizeit & Hobby", duration="2h", flex=True),
          ]
      
      
      @day(name="Prüfung")
      def pruefung(ctx):
          return [
              task("Ruhiger Kopf", start=morgen, duration="45m"),
              task("PRÜFUNG", start=time(10, 0), duration="2h", flex=False),
              task("Durchatmen & Feiern", start=pausetastisch, duration="2h"),
          ]
      
      
      def _feiertag(geben_date):
          return [

                  ]
              return monatsanfang

      """Schlafen bis zum naechsten Event - sogar im naechsten Tag.

      genau bis zum ersten Event des naechsten A*k*tiven* Tages und endet mitten in
      das, was als Naechstes kommt - freie Tage werden uebersprungen. Kein Wecker,
      keine feste Zeit: Der Plan selbst sagt dir, wann morgen wieder Leben ist.

      the ``location`` line. The day functions use ``ctx.prayer`` (not the
      module-level ``prayer`` name, which holds the config above). Run it with:

          dir3 plan/prayers_mwl.py --until 30 --offline --compile

      from datetime import timedelta

      # lat, lon, IANA timezone. Commented out: dir3 auto-detects via Geolocation.
      # location = (40.7992, 29.4305, "Europe/Istanbul")
      
      # --- Prayer calculation: Muslim World League, explicit -----------------------
      # Aladhan method id 3 (Fajr 18°, Isha 17°), Shafi school, no auto-pick.
      prayer = {"method": 3, "school": 0, "method_auto": False}

          return [
              task("Fajr", start=p.sunrise - timedelta(minutes=30), duration=timedelta(minutes=20)),
              task("Dhuhr", start=p.dhuhr, duration=timedelta(minutes=15)),
              task("Asr", start=p.asr, duration=timedelta(minutes=15)),
              task("Maghrib", start=p.maghrib, duration=timedelta(minutes=15)),
              task("Isha", start=p.isha, duration=timedelta(minutes=20)),
          ]
      
      
      def make_plan():
          return week(
              mon=prayer_day,
              tue=prayer_day,
              wed=prayer_day,
              thu=prayer_day,
              fri=prayer_day,
              sat=prayer_day,
              sun=prayer_day,
          )
      
      
      __title__ = "Prayers (Muslim World League)"

  content: |
      """Google Calendar sync via aiogoogle (async).
      
      Der Sync schiebt einen kompilierten :class:`Plan` als Events in Google
      Calendar.  Credentials liegen im Python-Planfile (``gcal = GoogleCalendar(...)``)
      - gleiche Philosophie wie der Rest von dir3.
      
      Idempotenz: jedes Event bekommt eine deterministische Custom-ID (plain
      SHA1-Hex über Titel/Tag/Name/Zeiten).  Die ID steht im Insert-Body
      (base32hex-konform), also meldet ein erneuter Lauf desselben Plans ``409``
      und aktualisiert (PUT) statt zu duplizieren.
      
      Parallelitaet: Jeder Tag bekommt seine eigene Upload-Task - alle Tage laufen
      gleichzeitig (``asyncio.gather``), begrenzt durch ``max_parallel_days``.
      Innerhalb eines Tages fliegen Inserts/Updates als aiogoogle-Batches
      (``as_user(*requests)``, max. ``BATCH_SIZE`` pro Batch) gleichzeitig raus.
      
      Auth (OAuth2, via aiogoogle):
        * ``refresh_token`` + ``client_id``/``client_secret`` -> automatischer
          Refresh beim ersten Request des Laufs;
        * oder ein bereits ausgestelltes ``access_token`` wird direkt benutzt.
      """
      from __future__ import annotations
      
      import asyncio
      import hashlib
      from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Callable
      from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
      from dataclasses import dataclass
      from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
      
      from aiogoogle import Aiogoogle
      from aiogoogle.auth.creds import ClientCreds, UserCreds
      
      from ..color import ColorPolicy, DefaultIconPolicy, PrayerColorPolicy, to_gcal_color_id
      from ..config import GoogleCalendar
      from .geo import _resolve_tz
      
      #: Minimaler Umfang - dir3 legt nur Events an/aktualisiert sie, liest nie.
      SCOPES = ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events"]
      
      #: Direkt gegebenes Access-Token gilt für den (kurzen) Sync-Lauf als frisch,
      #: damit aiogoogle keinen Refresh ohne Refresh-Token versucht.
      _ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL = timedelta(hours=1)
      
      
      @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
      class StagedEvent:
          event_id: str
          summary: str
          body: dict[str, object]
          when: str
          day: str = ""
      
      
      @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
      class GCalSyncReport:
          total: int
          created: int
          updated: int
          dry_run: bool
      
          def __str__(self) -> str:
              verb = "geplant" if self.dry_run else "synchronisiert"
              noun = "Event" if self.total == 1 else "Events"
              parts = [f"GCal: {self.total} {noun} {verb}"]
              if not self.dry_run:
                  parts.append(f"{self.created} neu, {self.updated} aktualisiert")
              return " · ".join(parts)
      
      
      @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
      class GCalClearReport:
          deleted: int
          dry_run: bool
      
          def __str__(self) -> str:
              noun = "Event" if self.deleted == 1 else "Events"
              if self.dry_run:
                  return f"GCal: wuerde {self.deleted} {noun} loeschen"
              return f"GCal: {self.deleted} {noun} geloescht"
      
      
      def _creds_for(settings: GoogleCalendar) -> tuple[UserCreds, ClientCreds | None]:
          """aiogoogle-Credentials aus den Planfile-Einstellungen bauen."""
          if settings.access_token:
              user_creds = UserCreds(
                  access_token=settings.access_token,
                  expires_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc) + _ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL,
              )
              return user_creds, None
          user_creds = UserCreds(refresh_token=settings.refresh_token)
          client_creds = ClientCreds(
              client_id=settings.client_id,
              client_secret=settings.client_secret,
              scopes=list(SCOPES),
          )
          return user_creds, client_creds
      
      
      @asynccontextmanager
      async def _open_client(
          settings: GoogleCalendar, timeout: float
      ) -> AsyncIterator[tuple[Aiogoogle, object]]:
          """Echte aiogoogle-Verbindung: Session + entdeckte Calendar-API liefern."""
          user_creds, client_creds = _creds_for(settings)
          async with Aiogoogle(user_creds=user_creds, client_creds=client_creds) as google:
              yield google, await google.discover("calendar", "v3")
      
      
      #: Öffnet ``(aiogoogle, calendar_api)`` - in Tests durch einen Fake ersetzbar.
      ClientFactory = Callable[[GoogleCalendar, float], object]
      
      #: Max. Events pro aiogoogle-Batch - ein Batch fliegt parallel raus
      #: (``as_user(*requests)``), Batches laufen nacheinander (API-Hoeflichkeit).
      BATCH_SIZE = 11
      
      #: Status, die einen Retry mit Backoff verdienen (Rate-Limits / flaky Server).
      _RETRYABLE_STATUS = {429, 500, 502, 503, 504}
      
      #: Retry-Versuche pro Batch + Start-Delay (verdoppelt sich pro Versuch).
      _MAX_TRIES = 4
      _RETRY_BASE_DELAY = 2.0
      
      
      def _is_rate_limited(res) -> bool:
          """True bei 403ern mit Rate-Limit-Grund (kein Auth-Problem)."""
          payload = getattr(res, "json", None) or {}
          if isinstance(payload, dict):
              error = payload.get("error") or {}
              details = error.get("errors") or []
              for detail in details:
                  if not isinstance(detail, dict):
                      continue
                  if "ratelimit" in str(detail.get("reason", "")).lower():
                      return True
              message = str(error.get("message", "")).lower()
              if "rate limit" in message or "ratelimit" in message:
                  return True
          text = str(getattr(res, "data", "") or "").lower()
          return "rate limit" in text or "ratelimit" in text
      
      
      def _response_kind(res) -> str:
          """``ok`` | ``conflict`` (409) | ``gone`` (404/410) | ``retry`` | ``fatal``."""
          code = res.status_code
          if 200 <= code < 300:
              return "ok"
          if code == 409:
              return "conflict"
          if code in (404, 410):
              return "gone"
          if code in _RETRYABLE_STATUS or (code == 403 and _is_rate_limited(res)):
              return "retry"
          return "fatal"
      
      
      async def _send_requests(google, pairs, *, timeout) -> list:
          """``(item, request)``-Batch senden, mit Retry bei Rate-Limits.
      
          Gibt fertige ``(item, response)``-Paare zurück (409/404/410 sind normale
          Outcomes, kein Retry); fatale Fehler raisen via ``res.raise_for_status()``.
          """
          pending = list(pairs)
          if not pending:
              return []
          finished = []
          delay = _RETRY_BASE_DELAY
          for attempt in range(_MAX_TRIES):
              last = attempt == _MAX_TRIES - 1
              responses = await google.as_user(
                  *(req for _, req in pending),
                  timeout=timeout,
                  full_res=True,
                  raise_for_status=False,
              )
              if not isinstance(responses, list):
                  responses = [responses]
              still = []
              for (item, _req), res in zip(pending, responses):
                  kind = _response_kind(res)
                  if kind == "retry" and not last:
                      still.append((item, _req))
                  elif kind == "fatal" or kind == "retry":
                      res.raise_for_status()
                  else:
                      finished.append((item, res))
              pending = still
              if not pending:
                  return finished
              await asyncio.sleep(delay)
              delay *= 2
          raise AssertionError("unerreichbar - letzter Versuch raist oder beendet immer")
      
      
      def _chunks(items: list, size: int):
          for index in range(0, len(items), size):
              yield items[index : index + size]
      
      
      class GoogleCalendarSyncer:
          def __init__(
              self,
              settings: GoogleCalendar,
              *,
              client_factory: ClientFactory | None = None,
              timeout: float = 10.0,
              max_parallel_days: int = 8,
              color_policy: ColorPolicy | None = None,
              icon_policy: object | None = None,
          ) -> None:
              self.settings = settings
              self._client_factory = client_factory or _open_client
              self.timeout = timeout
              self.max_parallel_days = max_parallel_days
              self._color_policy = color_policy or PrayerColorPolicy()
              self._icon_policy = icon_policy or DefaultIconPolicy()
      
          def stage(self, plan, *, timezone_name: str) -> list[StagedEvent]:
              """Alle aktiven Events als GCal-Payloads aufbauen (rein, kein Netzwerk).
      
              Der Engine arbeitet in Plan-Wanduhrzeit (naive datetimes); hier wird die
              Plan-Zeitzone attachiert, damit GCal absolute Zeitpunkte bekommt.
              """
              tz = _resolve_tz(timezone_name or "UTC")
              tz_label = getattr(tz, "key", None) or "UTC"
              staged: list[StagedEvent] = []
              for day_ in plan.days:
                  if not day_.active:
                      continue
                  position = 0
                  for ev in day_.events:
                      if not ev.active:
                          continue
                      start = _aware(ev.start, tz)
                      end = _aware(ev.end, tz)
                      fingerprint = "|".join(
                          (plan.title, day_.date.isoformat(), ev.name, start.isoformat(), end.isoformat())
                      )
                      event_id = hashlib.sha1(fingerprint.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
                      # Event-Zusammenfassung: gekürzter Name + Icon aus der IconPolicy
                      body_summary = event_summary(ev.name, self._color_policy, position)
                      body = {
                          "id": event_id,
                          "summary": body_summary,
                          "start": {"dateTime": start.isoformat(), "timeZone": tz_label},
                          "end": {"dateTime": end.isoformat(), "timeZone": tz_label},
                          "description": f"dir3 · {plan.title}",
                          "extendedProperties": {"private": {"dir3": "1"}},
                      }
                      color_id = to_gcal_color_id(self._color_policy.color_for(ev.name, position))
                      if color_id is not None:
                          body["colorId"] = color_id
                      position += 1
      
              # Event-Titel aktualisieren mit Icon und gekürztem Namen
              for staged_event in staged:
                  staged_event = staged_event  # keine in-place-Mutation möglich, da frozen
              # Wir müssen staged neu aufbauen - arbeiten an der Liste
              for i, ev in enumerate(staged):
                  staged[i] = StagedEvent(
                      event_id=ev.event_id,
                      summary=event_summary(ev.name, self._icon_policy, ev.day),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                      body=ev.body,
                      when=ev.when,
                      day=ev.day,
                  )
                      staged.append(
                          StagedEvent(
                              event_id=event_id,
                              summary=ev.name,
                              body=body,
                              when=start.isoformat(),
                              day=day_.date.isoformat(),
                          )
                      )
              staged.sort(key=lambda event: event.when)
              return staged
      
          async def sync(
              self,
              plan,
              *,
              timezone_name: str,
              dry_run: bool = False,
          ) -> GCalSyncReport:
              staged = self.stage(plan, timezone_name=timezone_name)
              if dry_run or not staged:
                  return GCalSyncReport(total=len(staged), created=0, updated=0, dry_run=dry_run)
      
              calendar_id = self.settings.calendar_id
              by_day: dict[str, list[StagedEvent]] = {}
              for event in staged:
                  by_day.setdefault(event.day, []).append(event)
      
              semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max(1, self.max_parallel_days))
              results: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
              async with self._client_factory(self.settings, self.timeout) as (google, calendar):
      
                  async def run_day(day_events: list[StagedEvent]) -> tuple[int, int]:
                      async with semaphore:
                          made, changed = 0, 0
                          for chunk in _chunks(day_events, BATCH_SIZE):
                              pairs = [
                                  (
                                      event,
                                      calendar.events.insert(
                                          calendarId=calendar_id, json=dict(event.body)
                                      ),
                                  )
                                  for event in chunk
                              ]
                              pending = []
                              for event, res in await _send_requests(
                                  google, pairs, timeout=self.timeout
                              ):
                                  if _response_kind(res) == "conflict":
                                      pending.append(event)
                                  else:
                                      made += 1
                              if pending:
                                  updates = [
                                      (
                                          event,
                                          calendar.events.update(
                                              calendarId=calendar_id,
                                              eventId=event.event_id,
                                              json=dict(event.body),
                                          ),
                                      )
                                      for event in pending
                                  ]
                                  changed += len(
                                      await _send_requests(google, updates, timeout=self.timeout)
                                  )
                          return made, changed
      
                  results = list(
                      await asyncio.gather(*(run_day(events) for events in by_day.values()))
                  )
              created = sum(made for made, _ in results)
              updated = sum(changed for _, changed in results)
              return GCalSyncReport(total=len(staged), created=created, updated=updated, dry_run=False)
      
          async def _list_ids(self, extra_params: dict) -> list[str]:
              """Event-IDs seitenweise einsammeln (Masters - direkt loeschbar)."""
              calendar_id = self.settings.calendar_id
              ids: list[str] = []
              page_token = None
              async with self._client_factory(self.settings, self.timeout) as (google, calendar):
                  while True:
                      params = {
                          "calendarId": calendar_id,
                          "maxResults": 2500,
                          "fields": "nextPageToken,items(id)",
                      }
                      params.update(extra_params)
                      if page_token:
                          params["pageToken"] = page_token
                      data = await google.as_user(
                          calendar.events.list(**params), timeout=self.timeout
                      )
                      ids.extend(item["id"] for item in data.get("items", []) if item.get("id"))
                      page_token = data.get("nextPageToken")
                      if not page_token:
                          return ids
      
          async def list_dir3_event_ids(self) -> list[str]:
              """Alle Events, die dir3 angelegt hat (Marker ``private.dir3=1``)."""
              return await self._list_ids(
                  {"singleEvents": True, "privateExtendedProperty": "dir3=1"}
              )
      
          async def list_all_event_ids(self) -> list[str]:
              """Alle Event-IDs im Kalender (fremde inklusive) - für ``--nuke``."""
              return await self._list_ids({})
      
          async def clear(self, *, dry_run: bool = False, nuke: bool = False) -> GCalClearReport:
              if nuke:
                  ids = await self.list_all_event_ids()
              else:
                  ids = await self.list_dir3_event_ids()
              if dry_run or not ids:
                  return GCalClearReport(deleted=len(ids), dry_run=dry_run)
              calendar_id = self.settings.calendar_id
              deleted = 0
              async with self._client_factory(self.settings, self.timeout) as (google, calendar):
                  for chunk in _chunks(ids, BATCH_SIZE):
                      pairs = [
                          (
                              event_id,
                              calendar.events.delete(calendarId=calendar_id, eventId=event_id),
                          )
                          for event_id in chunk
                      ]
                      # ok + gone (404/410, schon weg) zählen als erledigt
                      deleted += len(await _send_requests(google, pairs, timeout=self.timeout))
              return GCalClearReport(deleted=deleted, dry_run=False)
      
      
      def run_sync(syncer: GoogleCalendarSyncer, plan, *, timezone_name: str, dry_run: bool = False):
          """Sync-Wrapper für den synchronen CLI-Pfad."""
          return asyncio.run(syncer.sync(plan, timezone_name=timezone_name, dry_run=dry_run))
      
      
      def run_clear(syncer: GoogleCalendarSyncer, *, dry_run: bool = False, nuke: bool = False):
          """Clear-Wrapper für den synchronen CLI-Pfad."""
          return asyncio.run(syncer.clear(dry_run=dry_run, nuke=nuke))
      
      
      def _aware(dt, tz):
          return dt.astimezone(tz) if dt.tzinfo is not None else dt.replace(tzinfo=tz)

{

  "instructions": "Tests für die neue Icon-Policy und Namensverkürzungsfunktion",
  "content": "\"\"\"Tests für die Icon-Policy und Namensverkürzungsfunktionen.\"\"\"\nimport pytest\nfrom dir3.color import (\n    DefaultIconPolicy,\n    BasilPistazienColorPolicy,\n    event_summary,\n    shorten_event_name,\n)\n\nICONS = DefaultIconPolicy()\nCOLORS = BasilPistazienColorPolicy()\n\n\nclass TestIconPolicy:\n    \"\"\"Testet die Icon-Zuordnung nach den Vorgaben.\"\"\"\n\n    def test_prayer_icons(self):\n        \"\"\"Alle Gebete sollen mit 🕋 gekennzeichnet werden.\"\"\"\n        prayer_names = [\n            \"Fajr\",\n            \"Sunrise\",\n            \"Dhuhr\",\n            \"Asr\",\n            \"Maghrib\",\n            \"Isha\",\n            \"Jumuah\",\n            \"Duhr\",\n        ]\n        for name in prayer_names:\n            assert ICONS.icon_for(name, 0) == \"🕋\", f\"{name} should get 🕋\"\n\n    def test_lecture_icons(self):\n        \"\"\"Vorlesungen/Übungen sollen mit 🏫 gekennzeichnet werden.\"\"\"\n        lecture_names = [\n            \"EN 732 ROBS (Uebung, Marvin)\",\n            \"HE101 AnalinA (Winkert)\",\n            \"A053 ROBS (Uebung)\",\n            \"Vorlesung: Mathematik\",\n            \"Übung Analysis\",\n            \"Seminar: Thema XY\",\n        ]\n        for name in lecture_names:\n            assert ICONS.icon_for(name, 0) == \"🏫\", f\"{name} should get 🏫\"\n\n    def test_travel_icons(self):\n        \"\"\"Wege sollen mit 🛣️ gekennzeichnet werden.\"\"\"\n        travel_names = [\n            \"Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin, Galenstr. BUS 136\",\n            \"Travel to university\",\n            \"Fahrt nach Hause\",\n            \"Weg: A >> B\",\n            \"Commute\",\n        ]\n        for name in travel_names:\n            assert ICONS.icon_for(name, 0) == \"🛣️\", f\"{name} should get 🛣️\"\n\n    def test_event_summary_includes_icon(self):\n        \"\"\"event_summary soll Icon und Namen kombinieren.\"\"\"\n        assert event_summary(\"Fajr\", ICONS, 0) == \"🕋 Fajr\"\n        assert event_summary(\"EN 732 ROBS (Uebung, Marvin)\", ICONS, 0) == \"🏫 EN 732 ROBS (Uebung, Marvin)\"\n        assert event_summary(\"Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin\", ICONS, 0) == \"🛣️ Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin\"\n\n\nclass TestNameShortener:\n    \"\"\"Testet die Namensverkürzungsfunktion.\"\"\"\n\n    def test_shorten_lecture_names(self):\n        \"\"\"Lange Vorlesungsnamen werden gekürzt, aber Info bleibt.\"\"\"\n        assert shorten_event_name(\"EN 732 ROBS (Uebung, Marvin)\") == \"EN732 ROBS (Ü)\"\n        assert shorten_event_name(\"HE101 AnalinA (Winkert)\") == \"HE101 AnalinA (Winkert)\"\n        assert shorten_event_name(\"MA 751 IaD (Uebung)\") == \"MA751 IaD (Ü)\"\n\n    def test_shorten_travel_names(self):\n        \"\"\"Weg-Namen werden kompaktiert.\"\"\"\n        assert shorten_event_name(\"Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin, Galenstr. BUS 136\") == \"Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin\"\n\n    def test_shorten_prayer_names(self):\n        \"\"\"Gebetsnamen bleiben unverändert.\"\"\"\n        assert shorten_event_name(\"Fajr (Moschee)\") == \"Fajr (Moschee)\"\n        assert shorten_event_name(\"Asr (verschoben: Adhan 14:14 → 15:48)\") == \"Asr (verschoben: Adhan 14:14 → 15:48)\"\n\n    def test_event_summary_with_shortener(self):\n        \"\"\"Kombinierte Funktion: Icon + gekürzter Name.\"\"\"\n        assert event_summary(\"EN 732 ROBS (Uebung, Marvin)\", ICONS, 0) == \"🏫 EN732 ROBS (Ü)\"\n        assert event_summary(\"Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin, Galenstr. BUS 136\", ICONS, 0) == \"🛣️ Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin\"\n\n\nclass TestBasilPistazienColorPolicy:\n    \"\"\"Testet die neue Farbgebung für verschobene Gebete.\"\"\"\n\n    def test_am_adhan_im_moschee_basilikum(self):\n        \"\"\"Am Adhan im Moschee: Basilikum (Slot 9).\"\"\"\n        assert COLORS.color_for(\"Fajr (Moschee)\", 0) == 9\n        assert COLORS.color_for(\"Dhuhr (Moschee, nur Fardh)\", 0) == 9\n        assert COLORS.color_for(\"Asr (Moschee)\", 0) == 9\n\n    def test_verschoben_im_moschee_pistazie(self):\n        \"\"\"Verschoben im Moschee: Pistazie (Slot 10).\"\"\"\n        assert COLORS.color_for(\"Asr (Moschee, verschoben: Adhan 14:00 → 15:50)\", 0) == 10\n        assert COLORS.color_for(\"Dhuhr (Moschee, verschoben: Adhan 11:56 → 11:58)\", 0) == 10\n\n    def test_am_adhan_allein_avokado(self):\n        \"\"\"Am Adhan allein: Avokado (Slot 3).\"\"\"\n        assert COLORS.color_for(\"Fajr (allein)\", 0) == 3\n        assert COLORS.color_for(\"Isha (allein, nur Fardh)\", 0) == 3\n\n    def test_verschoben_allein_zitrone(self):\n        \"\"\"Verschoben allein: Zitrone (Slot 1).\"\"\"\n        assert COLORS.color_for(\"Maghrib (allein, verschoben: Adhan 16:42 → 17:48)\", 0) == 1\n\n    def test_im_kerahat_mandarine(self):\n        \"\"\"Im Kerahat: Mandarine (Slot 5).\"\"\"\n        assert COLORS.color_for(\"Asr (Kerahat, noch 42 min bis Maghrib-Adhan)\", 0) == 5\n        assert COLORS.color_for(\"Asr (Moschee, nur Fardh, Kerahat, noch 42 min bis Maghrib-Adhan)\", 0) == 5\n\n    def test_kritisch_tomate(self):\n        \"\"\"Kritisch: Tomate (Slot 4).\"\"\"\n        assert COLORS.color_for(\"Maghrib (kritisch, noch 14 min bis Isha-Adhan)\", 0) == 4\n        assert COLORS.color_for(\"Isha (!! anders nicht möglich, allein, nur Fardh, kritisch, noch 12 min bis Fajr-Adhan)\", 0) == 4\n\n    def test_fallback_to_name_hash(self):\n        \"\"\"Nicht-Gebets-Events fallen auf Namen-Hash zurück.\"\"\"\n        # Ein nicht-Gebet-Event sollte auf den Namen-Hash fallen\n       NonPrayer = COLORS.color_for(\"Coding\", 0)\n        assert NonPrayer is not None  # Sollte einen Hash haben\n        assert NonPrayer != 9  # Sollte nicht Basilikum sein\n"
}
