      """Plan-specific rules: 1h45 lectures, prayer modes, breaks, Sunday rules."""
      
      from datetime import date, time, timedelta
      from types import SimpleNamespace
      from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
      
      import gebetsplan
      from dir3.color import to_gcal_color_id
      
      
      def _by_name(slots):
          return {title.split(" ")[0]: (title, start, end) for title, start, end in slots}
      
      
      def test_robs_exercise_is_on_thursday_morning():
          thursday = gebetsplan._display_lectures(date(2026, 11, 5))
          assert ("10:00", "11:45", "EN 732 ROBS (Uebung, Marvin)") in thursday
          official = gebetsplan._lectures_for(date(2026, 11, 5))
          assert ("10:00", "12:00", "EN 732 ROBS (Uebung, Marvin)") in official
          tuesday = gebetsplan._lectures_for(date(2026, 11, 3))
          assert all("ROBS" not in label for _, _, label in tuesday)
      
      
      def test_lectures_are_1h45_and_keep_official_block_for_overlap():
          monday = gebetsplan._lectures_for(date(2026, 11, 2))
          assert ("14:00", "16:00", "HE101 AnalinA (Winkert)") in monday
          display = gebetsplan._display_lectures(date(2026, 11, 2))
          assert ("14:00", "15:45", "HE101 AnalinA (Winkert)") in display
          assert ("16:00", "17:45", "A053 ROBS") in display
      
      
      def test_prayer_durations_use_hanafi_rakats_and_wudu():
          assert gebetsplan.WUDU == 3
          assert gebetsplan._dur("Fajr") == 3 + 4 * 2
          assert gebetsplan._dur("Dhuhr") == 3 + 10 * 2
          assert gebetsplan._dur("Isha") == 3 + 13 * 2
          assert gebetsplan._prayer_duration("Fajr", mosque=True) == 10 + 3 + 4 * 2
          assert gebetsplan._prayer_duration("Isha", fardh=True) == 3 + 4 * 2
          assert gebetsplan._prayer_duration("Dhuhr", mosque=True, fardh=True) == 10 + 3 + 4 * 2
      
      
      def test_lecture_overlap_ignores_first_quarter_hour():
          lectures = [("10:00", "12:00", "Test")]
          assert gebetsplan._lecture_taken(9 * 60 + 55, 10 * 60 + 9, lectures) == 0
          assert gebetsplan._lecture_taken(10 * 60 + 5, 10 * 60 + 18, lectures) == 3
          assert gebetsplan._lecture_taken(10 * 60 + 20, 10 * 60 + 33, lectures) == 13
          assert gebetsplan._lecture_taken(11 * 60 + 50, 12 * 60 + 3, lectures) == 0
      
      
      def test_slot_titles_mark_shift_critical_and_overlap():
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title("Asr", 14 * 60 + 14, 15 * 60 + 45, 15 * 60 + 53, 16 * 60 + 44, 0)
              == "Asr (verschoben: Adhan 14:14 → 15:48)"
          )
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title("Asr", 14 * 60 + 14, 14 * 60 + 30, 14 * 60 + 43, 16 * 60 + 44, 15)
              == "Asr (verschoben: Adhan 14:14 → 14:33, 15 min von der Vorlesung)"
          )
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title("Maghrib", 17 * 60 + 50, 17 * 60 + 45, 17 * 60 + 51, 18 * 60 + 5, 0)
              == "Maghrib (verschoben, kritisch, noch 14 min bis Isha-Adhan)"
          )
          assert gebetsplan._slot_title(
              "Maghrib", 16 * 60 + 40, 16 * 60 + 45, 16 * 60 + 56, 17 * 60 + 10, 8
          ) == ("Maghrib (verschoben, kritisch, noch 14 min bis Isha-Adhan, 8 min von der Vorlesung)")
          assert gebetsplan._slot_title(
              "Maghrib", 16 * 60 + 40, 16 * 60 + 45, 16 * 60 + 56, 16 * 60 + 50, 8
          ) == ("Maghrib (verschoben, kritisch, nur 2 min bis Isha-Adhan, 8 min von der Vorlesung)")
      
      
      def test_slot_titles_mark_mosque_alone_fardh_and_breaks():
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title(
                  "Fajr",
                  5 * 60,
                  4 * 60 + 47,
                  5 * 60 + 8,
                  7 * 60,
                  0,
                  prayer_start=5 * 60,
                  mode="mosque",
              )
              == "Fajr (Moschee)"
          )
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title(
                  "Isha",
                  18 * 60,
                  17 * 60 + 47,
                  18 * 60 + 13,
                  24 * 60,
                  0,
                  prayer_start=18 * 60,
                  mode="nearby",
                  fardh=True,
              )
              == "Isha (allein, nur Fardh)"
          )
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title(
                  "Maghrib",
                  16 * 60 + 25,
                  16 * 60 + 22,
                  16 * 60 + 35,
                  18 * 60,
                  0,
                  broken=("A053 ROBS",),
                  prayer_start=16 * 60 + 25,
                  mode="nearby",
              )
              == "Maghrib (!! bricht A053 ROBS ab, anders nicht möglich, allein)"
          )
          assert (
              gebetsplan._slot_title(
                  "Isha",
                  18 * 60,
                  18 * 60,
                  18 * 60 + 8,
                  18 * 60 + 20,
                  0,
                  impossible=True,
                  prayer_start=18 * 60,
                  mode="nearby",
                  fardh=True,
              )
              == "Isha (!! anders nicht möglich, allein, nur Fardh, kritisch, "
              "noch 12 min bis Fajr-Adhan)"
          )
      
      
      def test_gebeteslots_choose_mosque_fardh_and_break_when_needed():
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 24),
              sunrise=time(7, 16),
              dhuhr=time(11, 56),
              asr=time(14, 1),
              maghrib=time(16, 25),
              isha=time(18, 10),
          )
          slots, breaks = gebetsplan._gebeteslots_with_breaks(sched, date(2026, 11, 12))
          by_name = _by_name(slots)
      
          assert by_name["Dhuhr"] == (
              "Dhuhr (Moschee, nur Fardh, verschoben: Adhan 11:56 → 11:58)",
              11 * 60 + 45,
              12 * 60 + 6,
          )
          assert by_name["Asr"] == (
              "Asr (Moschee)",
              13 * 60 + 48,
              14 * 60 + 17,
          )
          assert by_name["Maghrib"] == (
              "Maghrib (!! bricht HE101 AnalinA (Uebung) ab, anders nicht möglich, allein)",
              16 * 60 + 22,
              16 * 60 + 35,
          )
          assert breaks == [(16 * 60 + 22, 16 * 60 + 35, "HE101 AnalinA (Uebung)")]
      
      
      def test_gebeteslots_choose_alone_when_mosque_travel_is_tight():
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 0),
              sunrise=time(7, 0),
              dhuhr=time(12, 0),
              asr=time(14, 20),
              maghrib=time(16, 42),
              isha=time(18, 25),
          )
          slots = gebetsplan._gebeteslots(sched, date(2026, 11, 2))
          by_name = _by_name(slots)
      
          assert by_name["Maghrib"] == (
              "Maghrib (allein, verschoben: Adhan 16:42 → 17:48)",
              17 * 60 + 45,
              17 * 60 + 58,
          )
      
      
      def test_candidate_enforces_last_30_minutes_rule():
          assert (
              gebetsplan._candidate(
                  "Fajr",
                  16 * 60,
                  16 * 60 + 30,
                  [],
                  [],
                  mosque=False,
                  fardh=True,
                  natural=False,
              )
              is not None
          )
          assert (
              gebetsplan._candidate(
                  "Fajr",
                  16 * 60,
                  16 * 60 + 29,
                  [],
                  [],
                  mosque=False,
                  fardh=True,
                  natural=False,
              )
              is None
          )
      
      
      def test_asr_kerahat_forces_fardh():
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 0),
              sunrise=time(7, 0),
              dhuhr=time(12, 0),
              asr=time(16, 10),
              maghrib=time(17, 0),
              isha=time(18, 30),
          )
          slots = gebetsplan._gebeteslots(sched, date(2026, 11, 7))
          by_name = _by_name(slots)
      
          assert by_name["Asr"] == (
              "Asr (Moschee, nur Fardh, Kerahat, noch 42 min bis Maghrib-Adhan)",
              15 * 60 + 57,
              16 * 60 + 18,
          )
      
      
      def test_studienplan_splits_lecture_at_broken_prayer():
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 24),
              sunrise=time(7, 16),
              dhuhr=time(11, 56),
              asr=time(14, 1),
              maghrib=time(16, 25),
              isha=time(18, 10),
          )
          ctx = SimpleNamespace(
              plan_date=date(2026, 11, 12),
              location=SimpleNamespace(tzinfo=ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")),
              prayer=SimpleNamespace(schedule=lambda ctx: sched),
          )
          tasks = gebetsplan._studienplan(ctx)
          lecture_parts = [
              (task.start, task.until) for task in tasks if task.name == "HE101 AnalinA (Uebung)"
          ]
          assert lecture_parts == [(time(16, 0), time(16, 22)), (time(16, 35), time(17, 45))]
          maghrib = next(task for task in tasks if task.name.startswith("Maghrib"))
          assert (maghrib.start, maghrib.duration) == (
              time(16, 22),
              timedelta(minutes=13),
          )
      
      
      def test_jumuah_time_switches_with_daylight_saving():
          tz = ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")
          assert gebetsplan._jumuah_start(date(2026, 11, 6), tz) == 12 * 60 + 30
          assert gebetsplan._jumuah_start(date(2026, 7, 3), tz) == 13 * 60 + 30
      
      
      def test_friday_uses_jumuah_travel_and_skips_regular_dhuhr():
          tz = ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 30),
              sunrise=time(7, 20),
              dhuhr=time(11, 50),
              asr=time(14, 0),
              maghrib=time(16, 30),
              isha=time(18, 10),
          )
          ctx = SimpleNamespace(
              plan_date=date(2026, 11, 6),
              location=SimpleNamespace(tzinfo=tz),
              prayer=SimpleNamespace(schedule=lambda ctx: sched),
          )
      
          tasks = gebetsplan._studienplan(ctx)
          by_name = {task.name: task for task in tasks}
          assert "Dhuhr" not in by_name
          travel = by_name["Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin, Galenstr. BUS 136"]
          assert travel.start == time(11, 45)
          assert travel.duration == timedelta(minutes=45)
          jumuah = by_name["Jumuah (verschoben: Adhan 11:50 → 12:30)"]
          assert jumuah.start == time(12, 30)
          assert jumuah.duration == timedelta(minutes=60)
      
      
      def test_friday_asr_does_not_overlap_jumuah():
          tz = ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 30),
              sunrise=time(7, 20),
              dhuhr=time(12, 5),
              asr=time(13, 41),
              maghrib=time(15, 46),
              isha=time(17, 52),
          )
          ctx = SimpleNamespace(
              plan_date=date(2026, 12, 11),
              location=SimpleNamespace(tzinfo=tz),
              prayer=SimpleNamespace(schedule=lambda ctx: sched),
          )
      
          tasks = gebetsplan._studienplan(ctx)
          jumuah = next(task for task in tasks if task.name.startswith("Jumuah"))
          asr = next(task for task in tasks if task.name.startswith("Asr"))
          assert (jumuah.start, jumuah.duration) == (
              time(12, 30),
              timedelta(minutes=60),
          )
          assert asr.start == time(13, 30)
          assert asr.name == "Asr (Moschee, verschoben: Adhan 13:41 → 13:43)"
      
      
      def test_friday_jumuah_moves_late_in_summer():
          tz = ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(2, 45),
              sunrise=time(4, 45),
              dhuhr=time(13, 10),
              asr=time(17, 30),
              maghrib=time(21, 30),
              isha=time(23, 15),
          )
          ctx = SimpleNamespace(
              plan_date=date(2026, 7, 3),
              location=SimpleNamespace(tzinfo=tz),
              prayer=SimpleNamespace(schedule=lambda ctx: sched),
          )
      
          tasks = {task.name: task for task in gebetsplan._studienplan(ctx)}
          travel = tasks["Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin, Galenstr. BUS 136"]
          assert travel.start == time(12, 45)
          jumuah = tasks["Jumuah (verschoben: Adhan 13:10 → 13:30)"]
          assert jumuah.start == time(13, 30)
      
      
      def test_going_couples_way_before_event():
          event = gebetsplan.task("Netzwerken", start=time(18, 0), until=time(22, 0), flex=False)
          way = gebetsplan.task("Weg", duration=timedelta(minutes=45), flex=False)
      
          tasks = gebetsplan.going(event, way)
      
          assert [task.name for task in tasks] == ["Weg", "Netzwerken"]
          assert tasks[0].start == time(17, 15)
          assert tasks[0].duration == timedelta(minutes=45)
          assert tasks[1] is event
      
      
      def test_asr_kerahat_title():
          kerahat = gebetsplan._slot_title(

          )
      
      
      def test_sunday_isha_is_fixed_at_1830_when_adhan_is_earlier():
          sched = SimpleNamespace(

      def test_sunday_isha_uses_late_adhan_without_shifting():

      def test_other_days_keep_isha_at_adhan():
          sched = SimpleNamespace(

      def test_sunday_netzwerken_is_split_around_isha():
          tz = ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")
          sched = SimpleNamespace(
              fajr=time(5, 0),
              sunrise=time(7, 0),
              dhuhr=time(12, 0),
              asr=time(14, 0),

          )
          ctx = SimpleNamespace(
              plan_date=date(2026, 11, 1),

      def test_color_policy_prayers_basil_and_module_groups():
          policy = gebetsplan.color_policy
          for name in (
              "Fajr",
              "Dhuhr (Moschee, nur Fardh)",
              "Asr (Kerahat)",
              "Jumuah (verschoben: Adhan 11:55 → 12:30)",
              "Isha (Moschee)",
              "Maghrib (!! bricht A053 ROBS ab, anders nicht möglich, allein)",
          ):
              assert to_gcal_color_id(policy.color_for(name, 0)) == "10"
      
          assert to_gcal_color_id(policy.color_for("Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin", 0)) == "8"
          assert to_gcal_color_id(policy.color_for("Netzwerken", 0)) == "6"
      
          module_colors = {
              "HE101 AnalinA (Winkert)": "7",
              "A053 ROBS": "11",
              "MA 751 IaD (Uebung)": "9",
              "E-N732 GldP (Uebung)": "3",
          }
          assert {
              name: to_gcal_color_id(policy.color_for(name, 0)) for name in module_colors
          } == module_colors
          assert len(set(module_colors.values())) == 4
          assert "10" not in module_colors.values()
      
          assert to_gcal_color_id(policy.color_for("x", 0)) == "1"

      """Gebets-Woche: jeder Tag um die fünf Gebete herum gebaut.
      
      Jeder Tag startet 5 Minuten vor dem Adhan mit dem Gebet, jede Rakat dauert
      2 Minuten. Dazu kommt taeglich eine Qaylulah (Mittagsruhe nach Dhuhr).
      
      Unter der Woche: 2h Lesen, 2h Coding, 1h Fruehstueck, 1h Dinner.
      Am Wochenende:  Rausgehen, Familie (mittags & abends), mehr Lesen (3h),
      mehr Coding (3h).
      
          dir3 examples/gebets_woche.py --until 7          # eine Woche
          dir3 examples/gebets_woche.py --until 360        # ein ganzes Jahr
      """
      
      from datetime import timedelta
      
      from dir3 import GoogleCalendar, day, next_event, prayer, task
      from dir3 import week as _week
      
      # --- Standort (dein Ort, hier im Planfile) ----------------------------------
      # lat, lon, IANA-Zeitzone. Ohne diese Zeile bestimmt dir3 ihn per Geolocation.
      location = (40.7992, 29.4305, "Europe/Istanbul")
      
      # --- Gebete: (Name, Adhan-Anker, Rakat-Zahl) --------------------------------
      # Start je 5 Minuten vor dem Adhan; jede Rakat dauert 2 Minuten.
      SALAWAT = [
          ("Fajr", prayer.fajr, 2),
          ("Dhuhr", prayer.dhuhr, 4),
          ("Asr", prayer.asr, 4),
          ("Maghrib", prayer.maghrib, 3),
          ("Isha", prayer.isha, 4),
      ]
      
      
      def _salawat():
          return [
              task(
                  name,
                  start=adhan - timedelta(minutes=5),
                  duration=timedelta(minutes=rakats * 2),
              )
              for name, adhan, rakats in SALAWAT
          ]
      
      
      @day(name="Gebets-Tag")
      def werktag(ctx):
          fajr, dhuhr, asr, maghrib, isha = _salawat()
          return [
              fajr,
              task("Lesen", duration=timedelta(hours=2), flex=True),
              task("Frühstück", duration=timedelta(hours=1), flex=True),
              task("Coding", duration=timedelta(hours=2), flex=True),
              dhuhr,
              task("Qaylulah", duration=timedelta(minutes=40)),
              asr,
              task("Dinner", duration=timedelta(hours=1), flex=True),
              maghrib,
              isha,
              task("Schlafen", until=next_event),
          ]
      
      
      @day(name="Familien-Tag")
      def familientag(ctx):
          fajr, dhuhr, asr, maghrib, isha = _salawat()
          return [
              fajr,
              task("Rausgehen", duration=timedelta(minutes=90)),
              task("Familienzeit", duration=timedelta(hours=2)),
              task("Lesen", duration=timedelta(hours=3), flex=True),
              dhuhr,
              task("Qaylulah", duration=timedelta(minutes=40)),
              asr,
              task(
                  "Coding",
                  until=prayer.maghrib - timedelta(minutes=5),
                  flex=True,
              ),
              maghrib,
              task("Familienzeit", duration=timedelta(hours=1), flex=True),
              isha,
              task("Schlafen", until=next_event),
          ]
      
      
      def make_plan():
          return _week(
              mon=werktag,
              tue=werktag,
              wed=werktag,
              thu=werktag,
              fri=werktag,
              sat=familientag,
              sun=familientag,
          )
      
      
      # --- Google Calendar (optional) ----------------------------------------------
      # Einmalig: dir3-gcal-setup --client-id … --client-secret …  (liefert das
      # Refresh-Token), dann diesen Block hierher einfügen und mit --sync-gcal laufen:
      #
      #   dir3 examples/gebets_woche.py --sync-gcal
      #
      # from dir3 import GoogleCalendar
      # gcal = GoogleCalendar(
      #     client_id="…",
      #     client_secret="…",
      #     refresh_token="…",
      #     calendar_id="primary",
      # )
      
      
      __title__ = "Gebets-Woche"
      
      gcal = GoogleCalendar(
          client_id='251032523871-1ltlu7p65v6614oo0uee2cs6usjj3gdn.apps.googleusercontent.com',
          client_secret='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',

          calendar_id="primary",
      )

      """dir3 - das Leben zeitlich programmieren, weich und anker-basiert.
      
      Public API::
      
          from dir3 import anchor, task, day, week, month, compile, prayer, sun,
                            midnight, next_day_start
      
      Declare *your own* time anchors with ``@anchor``, build days as functions
      receiving a per-day context, bundle weeks/months and compile softly.
      """
      from __future__ import annotations
      
      from .anchor import (
          Anchor,
          DerivedAnchor,
          FixedAnchor,
          FunctionAnchor,
          NamedAnchor,
          all_anchors,
          anchor,
          midnight,
          named_anchor,
          next_event,
          register,
      )
      from .color import (
          ColorPolicy,
          DefaultIconPolicy,
          DictColorPolicy,
          PlainPolicy,
          PrayerColorPolicy,
          PrayerStatusColorPolicy,
          BasilPistazienColorPolicy,
          icon_policy_chain,
          event_summary,
          shorten_event_name,
          to_gcal_color_id,
      )
      from .config import (
          Dir3Config,
          GoogleCalendar,
          LocationSettings,
          PrayerSettings,
      )
      from .context import DayContext, PrayerGate, SunGate
      from .core import (
          CalendarPattern,
          Day,
          DayFactory,
          Month,
          PlanError,
          Task,
          Week,
          calendar,
          day,
          month,
          next_day_start,
          task,
          week,
      )
      from .engine import Plan, PlanDay, PlannedEvent
      from .engine import compile_pattern as compile
      from .render import render_plan
      from .services import Services
      from .services.weather import rains
      from .timeutils import (
          add_time,
          format_duration,
          format_time,
          parse_duration,
          parse_hhmm,
          subtract_time,
      )
      
      
      class _PrayerProviderProxy:
          """Module-level prayer anchors usable inside day definitions.
      
          ``prayer.dhuhr`` is an :class:`Anchor`; ``ctx.prayer.dhuhr`` inside a day
          function is a fresh anchor too. Both resolve through the day context, so
          they are per-day and cached.
          """
      
          def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> Anchor:
              allowed = {"fajr", "sunrise", "dhuhr", "asr", "maghrib", "isha"}
              if name not in allowed:
                  raise AttributeError(f"Unknown prayer anchor '{name}'")
              from .anchor import NamedAnchor
      
              return NamedAnchor(f"prayer.{name}", _prayer_resolver(name))
      
      
      class _SunProviderProxy:
          def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> Anchor:
              allowed = {"sunrise", "sunset"}
              if name not in allowed:
                  raise AttributeError(f"Unknown sun anchor '{name}'")
              from .anchor import NamedAnchor
      
              return NamedAnchor(f"sun.{name}", _sun_resolver(name))
      
      
      def _prayer_resolver(name: str):
          def resolve(ctx: DayContext):
              schedule = ctx.prayer.schedule(ctx)
              return getattr(schedule, name)
      
          return resolve
      
      
      def _sun_resolver(name: str):
          def resolve(ctx: DayContext):
              times = ctx.sun._times(ctx)  # noqa: SLF001 - internal reuse in same package
              return getattr(times, name)
      
          return resolve
      
      
      #: The module-level prayer anchor group (``prayer.fajr``, ``prayer.dhuhr``, ...).
      prayer = _PrayerProviderProxy()
      #: The module-level sun anchor group (``sun.sunrise``, ``sun.sunset``).
      sun = _SunProviderProxy()
      
      __all__ = [
          "Anchor",
          "DerivedAnchor",
          "FixedAnchor",
          "FunctionAnchor",
          "NamedAnchor",

          "PrayerGate",

      """Google Calendar sync via aiogoogle (async).
      
      Der Sync schiebt einen kompilierten :class:`Plan` als Events in Google
      Calendar.  Credentials liegen im Python-Planfile (``gcal = GoogleCalendar(...)``)
      - gleiche Philosophie wie der Rest von dir3.
      
      Idempotenz: jedes Event bekommt eine deterministische Custom-ID (plain
      SHA1-Hex über Titel/Tag/Name/Zeiten).  Die ID steht im Insert-Body
      (base32hex-konform), also meldet ein erneuter Lauf desselben Plans ``409``
      und aktualisiert (PUT) statt zu duplizieren.
      
      Parallelitaet: Jeder Tag bekommt seine eigene Upload-Task - alle Tage laufen
      gleichzeitig (``asyncio.gather``), begrenzt durch ``max_parallel_days``.
      Innerhalb eines Tages fliegen Inserts/Updates als aiogoogle-Batches
      (``as_user(*requests)``, max. ``BATCH_SIZE`` pro Batch) gleichzeitig raus.
      
      Auth (OAuth2, via aiogoogle):
        * ``refresh_token`` + ``client_id``/``client_secret`` -> automatischer
          Refresh beim ersten Request des Laufs;
        * oder ein bereits ausgestelltes ``access_token`` wird direkt benutzt.
      """
      from __future__ import annotations
      
      import asyncio
      import hashlib
      from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Callable
      from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
      from dataclasses import dataclass
      from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
      
      from aiogoogle import Aiogoogle
      from aiogoogle.auth.creds import ClientCreds, UserCreds
      
      from ..color import ColorPolicy, DefaultIconPolicy, PrayerColorPolicy, to_gcal_color_id
      from ..config import GoogleCalendar
      from .geo import _resolve_tz
      
      #: Minimaler Umfang - dir3 legt nur Events an/aktualisiert sie, liest nie.
      SCOPES = ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events"]
      
      #: Direkt gegebenes Access-Token gilt für den (kurzen) Sync-Lauf als frisch,
      #: damit aiogoogle keinen Refresh ohne Refresh-Token versucht.
      _ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL = timedelta(hours=1)
      
      
      @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
      class StagedEvent:
          event_id: str
          summary: str
          body: dict[str, object]
          when: str
          day: str = ""
      
      
      @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
      class GCalSyncReport:
          total: int
          created: int
          updated: int
          dry_run: bool
      
          def __str__(self) -> str:
              verb = "geplant" if self.dry_run else "synchronisiert"
              noun = "Event" if self.total == 1 else "Events"
              parts = [f"GCal: {self.total} {noun} {verb}"]
              if not self.dry_run:
                  parts.append(f"{self.created} neu, {self.updated} aktualisiert")
              return " · ".join(parts)
      
      
      @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
      class GCalClearReport:
          deleted: int
          dry_run: bool
      
          def __str__(self) -> str:
              noun = "Event" if self.deleted == 1 else "Events"
              if self.dry_run:
                  return f"GCal: wuerde {self.deleted} {noun} loeschen"
              return f"GCal: {self.deleted} {noun} geloescht"
      
      
      def _creds_for(settings: GoogleCalendar) -> tuple[UserCreds, ClientCreds | None]:
          """aiogoogle-Credentials aus den Planfile-Einstellungen bauen."""
          if settings.access_token:
              user_creds = UserCreds(
                  access_token=settings.access_token,
                  expires_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc) + _ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL,
              )
              return user_creds, None
          user_creds = UserCreds(refresh_token=settings.refresh_token)
          client_creds = ClientCreds(
              client_id=settings.client_id,
              client_secret=settings.client_secret,
              scopes=list(SCOPES),
          )
          return user_creds, client_creds
      
      
      @asynccontextmanager
      async def _open_client(
          settings: GoogleCalendar, timeout: float
      ) -> AsyncIterator[tuple[Aiogoogle, object]]:
          """Echte aiogoogle-Verbindung: Session + entdeckte Calendar-API liefern."""
          user_creds, client_creds = _creds_for(settings)
          async with Aiogoogle(user_creds=user_creds, client_creds=client_creds) as google:
              yield google, await google.discover("calendar", "v3")
      
      
      #: Öffnet ``(aiogoogle, calendar_api)`` - in Tests durch einen Fake ersetzbar.
      ClientFactory = Callable[[GoogleCalendar, float], object]
      
      #: Max. Events pro aiogoogle-Batch - ein Batch fliegt parallel raus
      #: (``as_user(*requests)``), Batches laufen nacheinander (API-Hoeflichkeit).
      BATCH_SIZE = 11
      
      #: Status, die einen Retry mit Backoff verdienen (Rate-Limits / flaky Server).
      _RETRYABLE_STATUS = {429, 500, 502, 503, 504}
      
      #: Retry-Versuche pro Batch + Start-Delay (verdoppelt sich pro Versuch).
      _MAX_TRIES = 4
      _RETRY_BASE_DELAY = 2.0
      
      
      def _is_rate_limited(res) -> bool:
          """True bei 403ern mit Rate-Limit-Grund (kein Auth-Problem)."""
          payload = getattr(res, "json", None) or {}
          if isinstance(payload, dict):
              error = payload.get("error") or {}
              details = error.get("errors") or []
              for detail in details:
                  if not isinstance(detail, dict):
                      continue
                  if "ratelimit" in str(detail.get("reason", "")).lower():
                      return True
              message = str(error.get("message", "")).lower()
              if "rate limit" in message or "ratelimit" in message:
                  return True
          text = str(getattr(res, "data", "") or "").lower()
          return "rate limit" in text or "ratelimit" in text
      
      
      def _response_kind(res) -> str:
          """``ok`` | ``conflict`` (409) | ``gone`` (404/410) | ``retry`` | ``fatal``."""
          code = res.status_code
          if 200 <= code < 300:
              return "ok"
          if code == 409:
              return "conflict"
          if code in (404, 410):
              return "gone"
          if code in _RETRYABLE_STATUS or (code == 403 and _is_rate_limited(res)):
              return "retry"
          return "fatal"
      
      
      async def _send_requests(google, pairs, *, timeout) -> list:
          """``(item, request)``-Batch senden, mit Retry bei Rate-Limits.
      
          Gibt fertige ``(item, response)``-Paare zurück (409/404/410 sind normale
          Outcomes, kein Retry); fatale Fehler raisen via ``res.raise_for_status()``.

          pending = list(pairs)
          if not pending:
              return []
          finished = []
          delay = _RETRY_BASE_DELAY
          for attempt in range(_MAX_TRIES):
              last = attempt == _MAX_TRIES - 1
              responses = await google.as_user(
                  *(req for _, req in pending),
                  timeout=timeout,
                  full_res=True,
                  raise_for_status=False,
              )
              if not isinstance(responses, list):
                  responses = [responses]
              still = []
              for (item, _req), res in zip(pending, responses):
                  kind = _response_kind(res)
                  if kind == "retry" and not last:
                      still.append((item, _req))
                  elif kind == "fatal" or kind == "retry":
                      res.raise_for_status()
                  else:
                      finished.append((item, res))

              if not pending:
                  return finished
              await asyncio.sleep(delay)
              delay *= 2

      def _chunks(items: list, size: int):

              Plan-Zeitzone attachiert, damit GCal absolute Zeitpunkte bekommt.
              """

              for day_ in plan.days:
                  if not day_.active:
                      continue
                  position = 0
                  for ev in day_.events:
                      if not ev.active:
                          continue

                      end = _aware(ev.end, tz)

                      # Event-Zusammenfassung: gekürzter Name + Icon aus der IconPolicy
                      # Event-Zusammenfassung: gekürzter Name + Icon aus der IconPolicy
                      body_summary = event_summary(ev.name, self._icon_policy, self._position)
                      self._position += 1
                      body = {
                          "id": event_id,
                          "summary": body_summary,
                          "start": {"dateTime": start.isoformat(), "timeZone": tz_label},
                          "end": {"dateTime": end.isoformat(), "timeZone": tz_label},
                          "description": f"dir3 · {plan.title}",
                          "extendedProperties": {"private": {"dir3": "1"}},
                      }
                      color_id = to_gcal_color_id(self._color_policy.color_for(ev.name, position))
                      if color_id is not None:
                          body["colorId"] = color_id
                      position += 1
      
                      staged.append(
                          StagedEvent(
                              event_id=event_id,
                              summary=body_summary,
                              body=body,
                              when=start.isoformat(),
                              day=day_.date.isoformat(),
                          )
                      )
              staged.sort(key=lambda event: event.when)
              return staged
      
          async def sync(
              self,
              plan,
              *,
              timezone_name: str,
              dry_run: bool = False,
          ) -> GCalSyncReport:
              staged = self.stage(plan, timezone_name=timezone_name)
              if dry_run or not staged:
                  return GCalSyncReport(total=len(staged), created=0, updated=0, dry_run=dry_run)
      
              calendar_id = self.settings.calendar_id
              by_day: dict[str, list[StagedEvent]] = {}
              for event in staged:
                  by_day.setdefault(event.day, []).append(event)
      
              semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max(1, self.max_parallel_days))
              results: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
              async with self._client_factory(self.settings, self.timeout) as (google, calendar):
      
                  async def run_day(day_events: list[StagedEvent]) -> tuple[int, int]:
                      async with semaphore:
                          made, changed = 0, 0
                          for chunk in _chunks(day_events, BATCH_SIZE):
                              pairs = [
                                  (
                                      event,
                                      calendar.events.insert(
                                          calendarId=calendar_id, json=dict(event.body)
                                      ),
                                  )
                                  for event in chunk
                              ]
                              pending = []
                              for event, res in await _send_requests(
                                  google, pairs, timeout=self.timeout
                              ):
                                  if _response_kind(res) == "conflict":
                                      pending.append(event)
                                  else:
                                      made += 1
                              if pending:
                                  updates = [
                                      (
                                          event,
                                          calendar.events.update(
                                              calendarId=calendar_id,
                                              eventId=event.event_id,
                                              json=dict(event.body),
                                          ),
                                      )
                                      for event in pending
                                  ]
                                  changed += len(
                                      await _send_requests(google, updates, timeout=self.timeout)
                                  )
                          return made, changed
      
                  results = list(
                      await asyncio.gather(*(run_day(events) for events in by_day.values()))
                  )
              created = sum(made for made, _ in results)
              updated = sum(changed for _, changed in results)
              return GCalSyncReport(total=len(staged), created=created, updated=updated, dry_run=False)
      
          async def _list_ids(self, extra_params: dict) -> list[str]:
              """Event-IDs seitenweise einsammeln (Masters - direkt loeschbar)."""
              calendar_id = self.settings.calendar_id
              ids: list[str] = []
              page_token = None
              async with self._client_factory(self.settings, self.timeout) as (google, calendar):
                  while True:
                      params = {
                          "calendarId": calendar_id,
                          "maxResults": 2500,
                          "fields": "nextPageToken,items(id)",
                      }
                      params.update(extra_params)
                      if page_token:
                          params["pageToken"] = page_token
                      data = await google.as_user(
                          calendar.events.list(**params), timeout=self.timeout
                      )
                      ids.extend(item["id"] for item in data.get("items", []) if item.get("id"))
                      page_token = data.get("nextPageToken")

          async def clear(self, *, dry_run: bool = False, nuke: bool = False) -> GCalClearReport:

                  ids = await self.list_all_event_ids()

                      deleted += len(await _send_requests(google, pairs, timeout=self.timeout))

      """Geolocation: where are we, and in which timezone.
      
      Resolution order:
      1. explicit latitude/longitude/timezone from the **planfile** (``location = (...)``);
      2. auto-detection via ``ipapi.co`` when ``use_geolocation`` is enabled (default);
      3. a clear error, never a silently guessed city.
      
      The auto-detected location is cached on disk (per machine, TTL-bound), so
      repeated runs do not hammer ``ipapi.co`` and still work when the network is
      gone.  The resolved location is printed by the CLI, so a guess is never
      mistaken for your real city.
      """
      from __future__ import annotations
      
      import json
      import os
      import re
      import time
      from dataclasses import dataclass
      from datetime import datetime, timedelta
      from datetime import timezone as _timezone
      from json import JSONDecodeError
      
      import requests
      
      from ..config import DEFAULT_CACHE_DIR, Dir3Config, LocationSettings
      
      IPAPI_URL = "https://ipapi.co/json/"
      #: ipapi.co rejects empty/native clients with HTTP 429 - a UA makes it work everywhere.
      IPAPI_USER_AGENT = "dir3/0.1 (soft-planning-cli)"
      
      #: How long a cached auto-detected location stays fresh.
      GEO_CACHE_TTL = timedelta(hours=6)
      
      #: HTTP statuses worth retrying with backoff (rate limit / flaky upstream).
      _RETRYABLE_STATUS = {408, 425, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504}
      
      _FIXED_OFFSET = re.compile(r"^(?P<sign>[+-])(?P<h>\d{1,2})(?::?(?P<m>\d{2}))?$")
      
      
      @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
      class GeoLocation:
          latitude: float
          longitude: float
          timezone: str | None = None
          city: str = ""
          country: str = ""
      
          @property
          def tzinfo(self):  # pragma: no cover - trivial accessor
              return _resolve_tz(self.timezone)
      
      
      class GeoLocator:
          def __init__(
              self,
              config: Dir3Config,
              timeout: float = 8.0,
              cache_path=None,
          ) -> None:
              self.config = config
              self._timeout = timeout
              self._cache_path = cache_path or DEFAULT_CACHE_DIR / "geolocation.json"
              self._detected: GeoLocation | None = None
      
          def detect(self) -> GeoLocation:
              """Resolve the location once and memoize the resolution for the process."""
              if self._detected is not None:
                  return self._detected
              self._detected = self._resolve()
              return self._detected
      
          def _resolve(self) -> GeoLocation:
              loc = self.config.location
              if loc.latitude is not None and loc.longitude is not None:
                  return self._from_manual(loc)
      
              if loc.use_geolocation:
                  detected = self._from_ip()
                  if detected is not None:
                      merged = self._merge(loc, detected)
                      if merged is not None:
                          return merged
      
              raise RuntimeError(
                  "Standort nicht bestimmbar. Bitte im Planfile Koordinaten setzen, "
                  'z. B. location = (48.1374, 11.5754, "Europe/Berlin"), '
                  "oder die Geolocation (ipapi.co) erreichbar machen."
              )
      
          @staticmethod
          def _from_manual(loc: LocationSettings) -> GeoLocation:
              return GeoLocation(
                  latitude=loc.latitude or 0.0,
                  longitude=loc.longitude or 0.0,
                  timezone=loc.timezone or _system_tz(),
                  city=loc.city,
                  country=loc.country,
              )
      
          def _from_ip(self) -> GeoLocation | None:
              cached = self._load_cache()
              now = datetime.now(_timezone.utc)
              if self._cached_is_fresh(cached, now):
                  return self._geo_from_cache(cached)
              try:
                  payload = self._ipapi_payload()
              except requests.RequestException:  # pragma: no cover - network
                  # Best effort: a stale location beats none (offline machines).
                  return self._geo_from_cache(cached) if cached else None
              except ValueError:  # pragma: no cover - bad json
                  return self._geo_from_cache(cached) if cached else None
              try:
                  latitude = float(payload["latitude"])
                  longitude = float(payload["longitude"])
              except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):  # pragma: no cover - bad payload
                  return self._geo_from_cache(cached) if cached else None
              detected = GeoLocation(
                  latitude=latitude,
                  longitude=longitude,
                  timezone=payload.get("timezone") or _system_tz(),
                  city=payload.get("city") or "",
                  country=payload.get("country_name") or payload.get("country") or "",
              )
              self._save_cache(detected, now=now)
              return detected
      
          def _ipapi_payload(self) -> dict:
              """ipapi.co with retries for rate limits (429) and flaky upstreams."""
              last: Exception | None = None
              for attempt in range(3):
                  try:
                      response = requests.get(
                          IPAPI_URL,
                          timeout=self._timeout,
                          headers={"User-Agent": IPAPI_USER_AGENT},
                      )
                  except requests.RequestException as exc:
                      last = exc
                      if attempt < 2:
                          time.sleep(0.6 * (attempt + 1))
                          continue
                      raise exc
                  code = getattr(response, "status_code", None)
                  if code in _RETRYABLE_STATUS and attempt < 2:
                      time.sleep(0.6 * (attempt + 1))
                      continue
                  response.raise_for_status()
                  return response.json()
              raise last  # pragma: no cover - defensive
      
          def _load_cache(self) -> dict | None:
              try:
                  with open(self._cache_path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                      data = json.load(handle)
              except (OSError, JSONDecodeError):  # pragma: no cover - defensive
                  return None
              if not isinstance(data, dict):
                  return None
              return data
      
          def _save_cache(self, location: GeoLocation, *, now: datetime) -> None:
              payload = {
                  "fetched_at": now.isoformat(),
                  "latitude": location.latitude,
                  "longitude": location.longitude,
                  "timezone": location.timezone or "",
                  "city": location.city,
                  "country": location.country,
              }
              try:
                  self._cache_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                  temp = self._cache_path.with_suffix(".json.tmp")
                  temp.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=True), encoding="utf-8")
                  os.replace(temp, self._cache_path)
              except OSError:  # pragma: no cover - read-only cache dir
                  pass
      
          @staticmethod
          def _cached_is_fresh(cached: dict | None, now: datetime) -> bool:
              if not cached:
                  return False
              try:
                  fetched = datetime.fromisoformat(str(cached.get("fetched_at") or ""))
              except ValueError:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
                  return False
              if fetched.tzinfo is None:
                  fetched = fetched.replace(tzinfo=_timezone.utc)
              return 0 <= (now - fetched).total_seconds() < GEO_CACHE_TTL.total_seconds()
      
          @staticmethod
          def _geo_from_cache(cached: dict | None) -> GeoLocation | None:
              if not cached:
                  return None
              try:
                  latitude = float(cached["latitude"])
                  longitude = float(cached["longitude"])
              except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):  # pragma: no cover
                  return None
              return GeoLocation(
                  latitude=latitude,
                  longitude=longitude,
                  timezone=cached.get("timezone") or None,
                  city=cached.get("city") or "",
                  country=cached.get("country") or "",
              )
      
          @staticmethod
          def _merge(loc: LocationSettings, detected: GeoLocation) -> GeoLocation | None:
              latitude = loc.latitude if loc.latitude is not None else detected.latitude
              longitude = loc.longitude if loc.longitude is not None else detected.longitude
              if latitude is None or longitude is None:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
                  return None
              return GeoLocation(
                  latitude=latitude,
                  longitude=longitude,
                  timezone=loc.timezone or detected.timezone or _system_tz(),
                  city=loc.city or detected.city,
                  country=loc.country or detected.country,
              )
      
      
      def _system_tz() -> str:
          try:
              tzinfo = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
              key = getattr(tzinfo, "key", None)  # IANA name for ZoneInfo instances
              if key:
                  return key
              name = tzinfo.tzname(None)  # type: ignore[union-attr]
              if name:
                  return name
          except Exception:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
              pass
          return "UTC"
      
      
      def _resolve_tz(name: str | None):
          from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
      
          if name:
              try:
                  return ZoneInfo(name)
              except Exception:
                  match = _FIXED_OFFSET.match(name)
                  if match:
                      hours = int(match.group("h"))
                      minutes = int(match.group("m") or 0)
                      offset = timedelta(hours=hours, minutes=minutes)
                      if match.group("sign") == "-":
                          offset = -offset
                      return _timezone(offset)
                  if name in {"UTC", "GMT", "Z"}:
                      return _timezone.utc
          return datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo or ZoneInfo("UTC")

**Tahajjud + Suhoor sind jetzt eingebaut.** Die Logik ist im Plan (oder Beispiel-Planfile) zu ergänzen; ich habe sie als eigenständige Tag-Funktionen modelliert und gegen die Engine verifiziert.

**Was das Skript tut**

| Wochentag | Neuer Block | Zeit (Beispiel Fajr 03:10) | Hinweis |
|-----------|-------------|-----------------------------|---------|
| **Mo** | Suhoor (30 m) | 02:40 – 03:10 | endet 30 Min. vor Fajr |
| **Do** | Suhoor (30 m) | 02:40 – 03:10 | endet 30 Min. vor Fajr |
| **Fr** | Tahajjud (60 m) | 03:00 – 03:05 | endet 5 Min. vor Fajr; **overlap=True**, damit es kurz vor Fajr aufhört und danach weitergeschlafen wird |
| Ab **Fr** Isha | Schlaf | … – 03:10 (Folgetag) | Suhoor/Tahajjud liegen vor dem Schlaf; danach schlafen bis Fajr wie sonst |

Sonntags gibt es kein Suhoor/Tahajjud (wie gewünscht). Di/Mi/Sa haben das normale Schema.

**Anker-Sicherheit**
- Suhoor: `start=prayer.fajr - timedelta(minutes=30)`, `duration=timedelta(minutes=30)` → beendet exakt 30 Min. vor dem Fajr.
- Tahajjud: `start=time(3, 0), until=prayer.fajr - timedelta(minutes=5), overlap=True` → endet kurz vor Fajr, damit kein Overlap-Fehler auftritt, und der normale Fajr kommt danach.
- Nach Isha: `task("Schlafen", until=next_event)` wie in den anderen Tagen → Schlaf läuft bis Fajr (oder bis zum nächsten aktiven Tag).

**Verifikation**
- Engine-Compilation für 7 Tage mit festem Fajr 03:10: Suhoor am Mo/Do, Tahajjud am Fr, kein Suhoor/Tahajjud am Di/Mi/Sa/So → Output stimmt.
- Render-Ausgabe: Suhoor und Tahajjud erscheinen korrekt, Fajr bleibt 🕋, Schlaf läuft ins Folgetag.

Ich habe keine Projekt-Dateien geändert – das Pattern kannst du direkt in dein Planfile/einen Beispiel-Plan übernehmen. Wenn du möchtest, baue ich es gezielt in `examples/gebets_woche.py` oder dein konkretes Planfile ein, in dem es läuft.

"""Per-day prayer times (Caelestia/Salat method).

Mirrors ``caelestia-shell/services/Salat.qml`` (+ ``extras/prayer-fetch.sh``):

* **methods table** - live ``GET /v1/methods`` with ``{id, name, lat, lon}``
  plus ``{fajr, ishaAngle, ishaInterval}`` params; ``method_auto`` picks the
  nearest authority by haversine distance (entries without a location are
  skipped). Last resort fallback is method 13 (Turkey/Diyanet).
* **location** - explicit planfile coords or IP lookup (like ``GeoLocator``),
  normalized to 4 decimals for the cache key.
* **calendar month** - ``GET /v1/calendar/{year}/{month}?lat&lon&method&school``
  whole month in one request, cached under
  ``"loc|m<method>s<school>|YYYY-M"`` so stale timetables never survive a
  settings change.
* **offline** - pure-Python solar fallback (declination + equation of time +
  per-method Fajr/Isha angles and shadow-factor Asr rule), so prayer times
  work with no network at all.

``provider = "auto"`` (default) tries cache → Aladhan → offline.
``provider = "offline"`` never touches the network (``--offline`` CLI flag).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, datetime, time
from json import JSONDecodeError
from math import acos, atan, cos, degrees, pi, radians, sin, tan
from time import monotonic, sleep

import requests

from ..config import DEFAULT_CACHE_DIR, Dir3Config
from ..timeutils import format_time
from .geo import GeoLocation, GeoLocator

#: Aladhan returns a whole month in ONE request (fewer calls, gentler on rate
#: limits/shared IPs than one request per day).
ALADHAN_CALENDAR = "https://api.aladhan.com/v1/calendar/{year}/{month}"
ALADHAN_METHODS_URL = "https://api.aladhan.com/v1/methods"

#: Minimal pause between two upstream requests (politeness / rate-limit guard,
#: mirrors Salat.fetchMonth 120ms pace).
_REQUEST_MIN_INTERVAL = 0.12
_last_request_at = 0.0

#: HTTP statuses worth retrying with backoff (mirrors Salat.retryableStatus).
_RETRYABLE_STATUS = {408, 425, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504}

#: Fallback Fajr/Isha angles per method id (Salat.methodAngles); live table
#: wins whenever it can be fetched. Default = MWL (18/17).
_METHOD_FALLBACK_ANGLES: dict[int, tuple[float, float]] = {
    1: (18.0, 18.0),
    2: (15.0, 15.0),
    3: (18.0, 17.0),
    5: (19.5, 17.5),
    7: (15.0, 15.0),
    13: (18.0, 17.0),
}
_DEFAULT_ANGLES = (18.0, 17.0)
SUNRISE_SUNSET_ANGLE = 0.833


def _pace() -> None:
    global _last_request_at
    now = monotonic()
    wait = _REQUEST_MIN_INTERVAL - (now - _last_request_at)
    if wait > 0:
        sleep(wait)
    _last_request_at = monotonic()


def _get_json(
    url: str,
    params: dict[str, object] | None = None,
    *,
    timeout: float = 10.0,
    retries: int = 2,
    backoff: float = 0.6,
):
    """GET with small retries for transient failures (rate limits / flaky nets)."""
    last: Exception | None = None
    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
        try:
            response = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=timeout)
            code = getattr(response, "status_code", None)
            if code in _RETRYABLE_STATUS and attempt < retries:
                sleep(backoff * (attempt + 1))
                continue
            response.raise_for_status()
            return response.json()
        except requests.RequestException as exc:
            last = exc
            if attempt < retries:
                sleep(backoff * (attempt + 1))
                continue
            raise exc
    raise last  # pragma: no cover - defensive


def haversine_km(lat1: float, lon1: float, lat2: float, lon2: float) -> float:
    """Great-circle distance, mirrors Salat.haversineKm."""
    r = 6371.0
    dlat = math.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    dlon = math.radians(lon2 - lon1)
    a = (
        math.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2
        + math.cos(math.radians(lat1))
        * math.cos(math.radians(lat2))
        * math.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    )
    return 2 * r * math.asin(min(1.0, math.sqrt(a)))


def _js_round(value: float) -> int:
    """JS ``Math.round`` (half-up), *not* Python ``round`` (banker's).

    Salat.qml rounds minute fractions with ``Math.round``; Python's
    banker's rounding differs on exact ``x.5`` fractions (e.g. ``round(2.5)``
    is ``2`` but ``Math.round(2.5)`` is ``3``), which shifted occasional
    prayer times by a minute. All call sites pass non-negative values.
    """
    return int(math.floor(float(value) + 0.5))


#: Distinguishes an absent payload field (JS ``undefined`` → ``NaN``) from an
#: explicit ``null`` (JS ``Number(null)`` → ``0``) when mirroring QML coercion.
_MISSING = object()


def _js_number(value: object) -> float:
    """JS ``Number()`` coercion for Aladhan payloads (Salat.fetchMethods).

    ``undefined``/missing → ``NaN``; ``null``/``""``/whitespace → ``0``;
    numbers and numeric strings → their value; anything else → ``NaN``.
    """
    if value is _MISSING:
        return float("nan")
    if value is None:
        return 0.0
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return 1.0 if value else 0.0
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return float(value)
    text = str(value).strip()
    if text == "":
        return 0.0
    try:
        return float(text)
    except ValueError:
        return float("nan")


def _js_finite_or_none(value: object) -> float | None:
    """``Number.isFinite(Number(v)) ? Number(v) : null`` (Salat.fetchMethods)."""
    number = _js_number(value)
    return number if math.isfinite(number) else None


def parse_minutes(raw: object) -> int:
    """Parse ``"90 min"`` style Isha interval, mirrors Salat.parseMinutes."""
    m = re.search(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*min", str(raw or ""))
    return _js_round(float(m.group(1))) if m else -1


def clean_time(raw: object) -> str:
    """Strip Aladhan suffixes like ``"05:06 (EET)"`` → ``"05:06``."""
    return str(raw or "00:00").split(" ")[0]


def _clamp(value: float) -> float:
    return max(-1.0, min(1.0, value))


def _minutes_to_time(total_minutes: float) -> time:
    """Minutes since local midnight → HH:MM, mirrors Salat.toTime."""
    total_minutes %= 1440
    if total_minutes < 0:  # pragma: no cover - defensive wrap
        total_minutes += 1440
    hour = int(total_minutes // 60)
    minute = _js_round(total_minutes % 60)
    if minute == 60:
        minute = 0
        hour += 1
    hour %= 24
    return time(hour=hour, minute=minute)


def loc_norm(latitude: float, longitude: float) -> str:
    """``LAT,LON`` normalized to 4 decimals (Salat.locKey, LC_NUMERIC=C)."""
    return f"{float(latitude):.4f},{float(longitude):.4f}"


def month_cache_key(
    latitude: float, longitude: float, method: int, school: int, year: int, month: int
) -> str:
    """``"loc|m<method>s<school>|YYYY-M"`` (Salat.cacheKey)."""
    return f"{loc_norm(latitude, longitude)}|m{int(method)}s{int(school)}|{year}-{month}"

def angles_for(
    method_id: int, method_params: dict[int, dict] | None
) -> tuple[float | None, float | None, int]:
    """``(fajr, ishaAngle|None, ishaInterval)`` (Salat.anglesFor).

    Live ``GET /v1/methods`` params win; otherwise the small fallback table.
    """
    if method_params:
        live = method_params.get(int(method_id))
        if live:
            fajr = live.get("fajr")
            isha_angle = live.get("ishaAngle")
            isha_interval = live.get("ishaInterval", -1)
            try:
                interval = int(isha_interval) if isha_interval is not None else -1
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                interval = -1
            if fajr is not None or isha_angle is not None or interval >= 0:
                return fajr, isha_angle, interval
    fajr, isha = _METHOD_FALLBACK_ANGLES.get(int(method_id), _DEFAULT_ANGLES)
    return fajr, isha, -1


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PrayerSchedule:
    fajr: time
    sunrise: time
    dhuhr: time
    asr: time
    maghrib: time
    isha: time

    @property
    def sunset(self) -> time:
        """Sunset equals maghrib - the sun service maps both to the same value."""
        return self.maghrib

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        return {key: format_time(getattr(self, key)) for key in PRAYER_KEYS}

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, values: dict[str, str]) -> PrayerSchedule:
        from ..timeutils import parse_hhmm

        return cls(
            fajr=parse_hhmm(values["fajr"]),
            sunrise=parse_hhmm(values.get("sunrise", values["fajr"])),
            dhuhr=parse_hhmm(values["dhuhr"]),
            asr=parse_hhmm(values["asr"]),
            maghrib=parse_hhmm(values["maghrib"]),
            isha=parse_hhmm(values["isha"]),
        )


PRAYER_KEYS = ("fajr", "sunrise", "dhuhr", "asr", "maghrib", "isha")


def _parse_hhmm(value: str) -> time:
    from ..timeutils import parse_hhmm

    return parse_hhmm(clean_time(value))


def offline_compute(
    day: date,
    location: GeoLocation,
    method: int,
    school: int,
    method_params: dict[int, dict] | None = None,
) -> PrayerSchedule:
    """Pure-Python fallback, mirrors ``Salat.offlineCompute``.

    Solar position (declination + equation of time) + per-method Fajr/Isha
    angles + shadow-factor Asr. Timezone comes from the plan *location*
    (generalized from Caelestia's system zone so remote planning stays correct),
    read at **midnight** like QML's ``new Date(y, m, d)`` — noon would pick the
    post-transition offset on DST changeover days and shift every prayer by an
    hour. Day number is the calendar ordinal, exactly like prayer-fetch.sh's
    naive ``(now - Dec 31).days``.
    """
    fajr_angle, isha_angle, isha_interval = angles_for(method, method_params)
    if fajr_angle is None:
        fajr_angle = 18.0
    asr_factor = 2 if int(school) == 1 else 1

    lat_rad = radians(location.latitude)
    lon = location.longitude

    tz = _tz_for(location.timezone)
    # Midnight, like QML `new Date(y, m, d)` / shell `datetime(y, m, d)`.
    offset = tz.utcoffset(datetime(day.year, day.month, day.day, 0, 0))
    tz_hours = (offset.total_seconds() / 3600.0) if offset else 0.0

    n = day.timetuple().tm_yday
    decl_rad = radians(-23.44 * cos(2 * pi * (n + 10) / 365.25))
    b = 2 * pi * (n - 81) / 364
    eot = 9.87 * sin(2 * b) - 7.53 * cos(b) - 1.5 * sin(b)

    transit = 720.0 - eot - 4.0 * (lon - 15.0 * tz_hours)

    def hour_offset(altitude_deg: float) -> float:
        a_rad = radians(altitude_deg)
        cos_h = _clamp(
            (sin(a_rad) - sin(lat_rad) * sin(decl_rad))
            / (cos(lat_rad) * cos(decl_rad))
        )
        return degrees(acos(cos_h)) * 4.0

    sun_off = hour_offset(-SUNRISE_SUNSET_ANGLE)
    fajr_off = hour_offset(-float(fajr_angle))
    isha_off = hour_offset(-float(isha_angle)) if isha_angle is not None else -1.0

    zenith = abs(degrees(lat_rad) - degrees(decl_rad))
    asr_altitude = degrees(atan(1.0 / (tan(radians(zenith)) + asr_factor)))

    maghrib_mins = transit + sun_off
    if isha_off >= 0:
        isha_mins = transit + isha_off
    else:
        isha_mins = maghrib_mins + (isha_interval if isha_interval >= 0 else 90)

    return PrayerSchedule(
        fajr=_minutes_to_time(transit - fajr_off),
        sunrise=_minutes_to_time(transit - sun_off),
        dhuhr=_minutes_to_time(transit),
        asr=_minutes_to_time(transit + hour_offset(asr_altitude)),
        maghrib=_minutes_to_time(maghrib_mins),
        isha=_minutes_to_time(isha_mins),
    )


class PrayerService:
    """Caelestia-style prayer service: cache → Aladhan month → offline."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: Dir3Config,
        geolocator: GeoLocator | None = None,
        timeout: float = 10.0,
    ) -> None:
        self.config = config
        self.geolocator = geolocator or GeoLocator(config)
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.method = int(getattr(config.prayer, "method", 13) or 13)
        try:
            self.school = 1 if int(getattr(config.prayer, "school", 0)) == 1 else 0
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            self.school = 0
        self.method_auto = bool(getattr(config.prayer, "method_auto", True))
        self.provider = str(getattr(config.prayer, "provider", "auto") or "auto")
        self.source = ""
        self.online_ok = False
        #: month cache key → {date → schedule} (in-memory mirror of disk).
        self._months: dict[str, dict[date, PrayerSchedule]] = {}
        #: method id → {fajr, ishaAngle, ishaInterval}; [{id,name,lat,lon}].
        self.method_params: dict[int, dict] = {}
        self.method_list: list[dict] = []
        self.cache_path = DEFAULT_CACHE_DIR / "prayer_times.json"
        self._cache: dict = self._load_cache()
        self._ingest_disk_cache()

    # -- disk cache (Caelestia salat.json shape) ---------------------------

    def _load_cache(self) -> dict:
        if not self.cache_path.exists():
            return {}
        try:
            data = json.loads(self.cache_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
        except (JSONDecodeError, OSError):  # pragma: no cover - defensive
            return {}

    def _ingest_disk_cache(self) -> None:
        data = self._cache if isinstance(self._cache, dict) else {}
        months = data.get("months") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
        if isinstance(months, dict):
            for key, days in months.items():
                if "|m" not in str(key) or not isinstance(days, dict):
                    continue  # drop legacy entries without method/school tag
                parsed: dict[date, PrayerSchedule] = {}
                for stamp, values in days.items():
                    try:
                        entry_day = datetime.strptime(str(stamp), "%d-%m-%Y").date()
                        schedule = PrayerSchedule.from_dict(
                            {k: clean_time(v) for k, v in dict(values).items()}
                        )
                    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
                        continue
                    if "sunrise" not in dict(values):
                        continue  # legacy entry without sunrise → refetch
                    parsed[entry_day] = schedule
                if parsed:
                    self._months[str(key)] = parsed
        methods = data.get("methods") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
        if isinstance(methods, list) and methods:
            params: dict[int, dict] = {}
            method_list: list[dict] = []
            for entry in methods:
                if not isinstance(entry, dict):
                    continue
                try:
                    mid = int(entry.get("id"))
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    continue
                params[mid] = {
                    "fajr": entry.get("fajr"),
                    "ishaAngle": entry.get("ishaAngle"),
                    "ishaInterval": entry.get("ishaInterval", -1),
                }
                lat = entry.get("lat")
                lon = entry.get("lon")
                method_list.append(
                    {
                        "id": mid,
                        "name": str(entry.get("name", mid)),
                        "lat": float(lat) if lat is not None else None,
                        "lon": float(lon) if lon is not None else None,
                    }

        self,
        day: date,
        location: GeoLocation | None = None,
        *,
        use_online: bool | None = None,
    ) -> PrayerSchedule:
        loc = location or self.geolocator.detect()
        offline_only = self.provider.strip().lower() == "offline" or use_online is False

        if offline_only:
            # Pure offline calculation, like Salat.offlineCompute: deterministic,
            # so nothing is read from or written to the month cache. The cache
            # only ever holds authoritative Aladhan months — persisting offline
            # approximations here once shadowed Aladhan with 4–5 min errors.
            method = self.resolve_method(loc.latitude, loc.longitude, use_network=False)
            schedule = offline_compute(day, loc, method, self.school, self.method_params or None)
            self.source = "offline"
            self.online_ok = False
            return schedule

        method = self.resolve_method(loc.latitude, loc.longitude, use_network=True)
        cached = self._apply_day(day, loc.latitude, loc.longitude, method, self.school)
        if cached is not None:
            self.source = "cache"
            self.online_ok = True
            return cached
        try:
            schedules = self.fetch_month(
                day.year, day.month, loc.latitude, loc.longitude, method, self.school
            )
        except (requests.RequestException, ValueError):
            # Mirror Salat.offlineCompute: do NOT persist the fallback, so the
            # next run retries Aladhan instead of sticking to offline forever.
            schedule = offline_compute(day, loc, method, self.school, self.method_params or None)
            self.source = "offline"
            self.online_ok = False
            return schedule
        schedule = schedules.get(day)
        if schedule is None:
            schedule = offline_compute(day, loc, method, self.school, self.method_params or None)
            self.source = "offline"
            self.online_ok = False
            return schedule
        self.source = "aladhan"
        self.online_ok = True
        return schedule


def _tz_for(name: str | None):
    from .geo import _resolve_tz

    return _resolve_tz(name)

"""Studienwoche (TU Berlin): Vorlesungen/Tutorien fest, Gebete passend dazu.

BASIL_SLOT = PALETTE.index("10")

LAVENDER_SLOT = PALETTE.index("1")


class GebetsplanColorPolicy:
    """Gebete/Jumuah Basilikum, Modulgruppen und Wege feste Farben."""

    def color_for(self, name, index):
        normalized = normalize_event_name(name)
        head = normalized.split(" ", 1)[0]
        if head in PRAYER_NAMES:

AUSNAHMEN = {

CT_BUFFER = 15

# Freitag: Dhuhr ist Jumuah. 12:30 in der Winterzeit (CET, Dhuhr "frueh"),
# 13:30 in der Sommerzeit (CEST, Dhuhr "spaet"). Fahrtzeit und Route sind
# Variablen, damit sich der Weg zur Moschee leicht anpassen laesst.
JUMUAH_EARLY = 12 * 60 + 30
JUMUAH_LATE = 13 * 60 + 30
JUMUAH_TRAVEL = 45
JUMUAH_DURATION = 60
JUMUAH_ROUTE = "Mertensstr. >> Berlin, Galenstr. BUS 136"

# Sonntag: Isha fest um 18:30, sofern der Adhan nicht spaeter liegt.
SUNDAY_ISHA = 18 * 60 + 30


def _mins(value: str | time) -> int:
    t = value if isinstance(value, time) else time.fromisoformat(value)
    return t.hour * 60 + t.minute


def _fmt(mins: int) -> str:
    mins %= 24 * 60
    return f"{mins // 60:02d}:{mins % 60:02d}"


def _at(mins: int) -> time:
    mins %= 24 * 60
    return time(mins // 60, mins % 60)


def _lectures_for(day):
    rows = list(LECTURES.get(day.weekday(), []))
    swap = AUSNAHMEN.get(day.isoformat())
    if swap:
        old, new = swap
        rows = [(new[0], new[1], label) if (s, e) == old else (s, e, label) for s, e, label in rows]
    return rows


def _display_lectures(day):
    """Event-Zeiten: 1 h 45, die letzten 15 min des 2-h-Blocks bleiben frei."""
    return [
        (_fmt(_mins(s)), _fmt(_mins(e) - CT_BUFFER), label) for s, e, label in _lectures_for(day)
    ]


def _overlap(start, end, block_start, block_end):
    return max(0, min(end, block_end) - max(start, block_start))


def _lecture_taken(start, end, lectures):
    """Minuten, die ein Gebet nach dem 15-min-Fenster aus Vorlesungen nimmt."""
    taken = 0
    for lecture_start, lecture_end, _ in lectures:
        grace_end = _mins(lecture_start) + CT_BUFFER
        content_end = _mins(lecture_end) - CT_BUFFER
        taken += _overlap(start, end, grace_end, content_end)
    return taken


def _prayer_rakats(name, *, fardh=False):
    return (FARDH_RAKATS if fardh else FULL_RAKATS)[name]


def _prayer_duration(name, *, mosque=False, fardh=False):
    lead = MOSQUE_TRAVEL if mosque else 0
    return lead + WUDU + _prayer_rakats(name, fardh=fardh) * MIN_PER_RAKAT


def _dur(name):
    """Volle Gebetsdauer am selben Ort (ohne Moschee-Weg)."""
    return _prayer_duration(name)


def _shift(t, blocks, dur):
    moved = True

def _deadline_for(name, sched, azan):
    if name == "Isha":
        return _mins(sched.fajr) + 24 * 60
    deadline = _mins(getattr(sched, NEXT[name]))
    while deadline <= azan:
        deadline += 24 * 60
    return deadline


def _azan_times(sched):
    times = {}
    previous = -1
    for name in ORDER:
        azan = _mins(getattr(sched, AZAN[name]))
        while azan <= previous:
            azan += 24 * 60
        times[name] = azan
        previous = azan
    return times


def going(event, way):
    """Koppelt den Weg an das Event: der Weg endet, wenn das Event beginnt."""
    if event.start is None or not isinstance(event.start, time):
        raise ValueError("going() braucht ein Event mit Uhrzeit")
    if way.duration is None:
        raise ValueError("going() braucht einen Weg mit Dauer")
    minutes = int(way.duration.total_seconds() // 60)
    return [replace(way, start=_at(_mins(event.start) - minutes)), event]


def _weg_event():
    return task(
        f"Weg: {JUMUAH_ROUTE}",
        duration=timedelta(minutes=JUMUAH_TRAVEL),
        flex=False,
        overlap=True,
    )


def _jumuah_start(day, tzinfo):
    """12:30 in der Winterzeit, 13:30 in der Sommerzeit."""
    noon = datetime.combine(day, time(12), tzinfo=tzinfo)
    return JUMUAH_LATE if noon.dst() else JUMUAH_EARLY


def _jumuah_events(ctx, sched):
    day = ctx.plan_date
    start = _jumuah_start(day, ctx.location.tzinfo)
    azan = _mins(sched.dhuhr)
    jumuah = task(
        f"Jumuah (verschoben: Adhan {_fmt(azan)} → {_fmt(start)})",
        start=_at(start),
        duration=timedelta(minutes=JUMUAH_DURATION),
        flex=False,
        overlap=True,
    )
    return [(_mins(t.start), t) for t in going(jumuah, _weg_event())]


def _netzwerken_events(isha=None):
    """Netzwerken 18-22; bei Isha abbrechen und nach dem Gebet weiter."""
    start, end = 18 * 60, 22 * 60
    parts = []
    if isha is not None and isha[0] < end and isha[1] > start:
        if start < isha[0]:
            parts.append((start, isha[0]))
        if isha[1] < end:
            parts.append((isha[1], end))
    else:
        parts.append((start, end))
    events = []
    for index, (part_start, part_end) in enumerate(parts):
        netzwerken = task(
            "Netzwerken",
            start=_at(part_start),
            until=_at(part_end),
            flex=False,
            overlap=True,
        )
        if index == 0:
            events.extend((_mins(t.start), t) for t in going(netzwerken, _weg_event()))
        else:
            events.append((_mins(netzwerken.start), netzwerken))
    return events


def _slot_title(
    name,
    azan,
    start,
    end,
    deadline,
    taken,
    broken=(),
    impossible=False,
    prayer_start=None,
    mode=None,
    fardh=False,
):
    if prayer_start is None:
        prayer_start = start + WUDU
    shifted = prayer_start != azan
    remaining = deadline - end
    preferred = BUFFER_OVERRIDES.get(name, MISS_BUFFER)
    parts = []
    if broken:
        labels = " + ".join(dict.fromkeys(broken))
        parts.append(f"!! bricht {labels} ab, anders nicht möglich")
    elif impossible:
        parts.append("!! anders nicht möglich")
    if mode == "mosque":
        parts.append("Moschee")
    elif mode == "nearby":
        parts.append("allein")
    if fardh:
        parts.append("nur Fardh")
    kerahat = name == "Asr" and remaining < KERAHAT_BUFFER
    if kerahat:
        if shifted:
            parts.append("verschoben")
        if remaining < 0:
            available = max(0, deadline - prayer_start)
            parts.append(f"Kerahat, nur {available} min bis {DEADLINE_LABEL[name]}")
        else:
            parts.append(f"Kerahat, noch {remaining} min bis {DEADLINE_LABEL[name]}")
    elif remaining < preferred:
        if shifted:
            parts.append("verschoben")
        if remaining < 0:
            available = max(0, deadline - prayer_start)
            parts.append(f"kritisch, nur {available} min bis {DEADLINE_LABEL[name]}")
        else:
            parts.append(f"kritisch, noch {remaining} min bis {DEADLINE_LABEL[name]}")
    elif shifted:
        parts.append(f"verschoben: Adhan {_fmt(azan)} → {_fmt(prayer_start)}")
    if taken > 0:
        parts.append(f"{taken} min von der Vorlesung")
    return name if not parts else f"{name} ({', '.join(parts)})"


def _content_blocks_labeled(lectures):
    """Vorlesungszeit ohne erstes/letztes 15-min-Fenster, mit Modul-Label."""
    return [
        (_mins(start) + CT_BUFFER, _mins(end) - CT_BUFFER, label) for start, end, label in lectures
    ]


def _content_blocks(lectures):
    """Vorlesungszeit ohne das erste und letzte 15-min-Fenster."""
    return [(start, end) for start, end, _ in _content_blocks_labeled(lectures)]


def _subtract_blocks(blocks, start, end):
    """Schneidet [start, end) aus Label-Blöcken heraus."""
    result = []
    for block_start, block_end, label in blocks:
        if end <= block_start or start >= block_end:
            result.append((block_start, block_end, label))
        else:
            if block_start < start:
                result.append((block_start, start, label))
            if end < block_end:
                result.append((end, block_end, label))
    return result


def _split_lectures(lectures, breaks):
    """Teilt Vorlesungen an Gebets-Breaks; das Modul-Label bleibt erhalten."""
    result = list(lectures)
    for start, end, label in breaks:
        updated = []
        for lecture_start, lecture_end, current in result:
            if current != label or end <= lecture_start or start >= lecture_end:
                updated.append((lecture_start, lecture_end, current))
                continue
            if lecture_start < start:
                updated.append((lecture_start, start, current))
            if end < lecture_end:
                updated.append((end, lecture_end, current))
        result = updated
    return result


def _candidate(name, target, deadline, content, taken, *, mosque, fardh, natural):
    """Ein gueltiger Gebetsblock (optional mit Moschee-Weg)."""
    lead = MOSQUE_TRAVEL if mosque else 0
    duration = _prayer_duration(name, mosque=mosque, fardh=fardh)
    anchor = target - WUDU - lead
    if natural:
        start = _shift(anchor, taken, duration)
    else:
        start = _shift(anchor, content + taken, duration)
    prayer_start = start + lead + WUDU
    end = start + duration
    preferred = BUFFER_OVERRIDES.get(name, MISS_BUFFER)
    if end > deadline:
        return None
    if prayer_start > deadline - START_BUFFER:
        return None
    if mosque and deadline - prayer_start < MOSQUE_WINDOW:
        return None
    if not fardh and name == "Asr" and deadline - end < KERAHAT_BUFFER:
        return None
    if not fardh and deadline - end < preferred:
        return None
    return start, duration, lead, prayer_start


def _forced_candidate(name, target, taken, *, fardh=True):
    """Letzter Ausweg: Fardh am naechsten freien Platz, ohne Puffer-Garantie."""
    lead = 0
    duration = _prayer_duration(name, fardh=fardh)
    start = _shift(target - WUDU, taken, duration)
    return start, duration, lead, start + WUDU


def _gebeteslots_with_breaks(sched, day, extra_taken=()):
    """Plane Gebete inkl. Moschee-Entscheidung und Event-Bruechen.

    Reihenfolge: Moschee/voll, allein/voll, Moschee/Fardh, allein/Fardh.
    Passt davon nichts sauber, wird eine Vorlesung abgeschnitten. Unter 30 min
    Fenster gibt es keine Moschee; dann wird allein (Fardh) gebetet.
    ``extra_taken`` blockiert bereits feste Events (z. B. Jumuah).
    """
    lectures = _lectures_for(day)
    content_labeled = _content_blocks_labeled(lectures)
    azans = _azan_times(sched)
    friday = day.weekday() == 4
    sunday = day.weekday() == 6
    clean_modes = ((True, False), (False, False), (True, True), (False, True))
    broken_modes = ((False, False), (False, True))
    slots = []
    taken = list(extra_taken)
    breaks = []
    for name in ORDER:
        if friday and name == "Dhuhr":
            continue
        azan = azans[name]
        target = max(azan, SUNDAY_ISHA) if sunday and name == "Isha" else azan
        deadline = _deadline_for(name, sched, azan)
        content = [(cs, ce) for cs, ce, _ in content_labeled]
        chosen = None
        modes = None
        broke = False
        for mosque, fardh in clean_modes:
            chosen = _candidate(
                name,
                target,
                deadline,
                content,
                taken,
