  content: |
      """Gebets-Woche: jeder Tag um die fünf Gebete herum gebaut.
      
      Jeder Tag startet 5 Minuten vor dem Adhan mit dem Gebet, jede Rakat dauert
      2 Minuten. Dazu kommt taeglich eine Qaylulah (Mittagsruhe nach Dhuhr).
      
      Unter der Woche: 2h Lesen, 2h Coding, 1h Fruehstueck, 1h Dinner.
      Am Wochenende:  Rausgehen, Familie (mittags & abends), mehr Lesen (3h),
      mehr Coding (3h).
      
          dir3 examples/gebets_woche.py --until 7          # eine Woche
          dir3 examples/gebets_woche.py --until 360        # ein ganzes Jahr
      """
      
      from datetime import timedelta
      
      from dir3 import GoogleCalendar, day, next_event, prayer, task
      from dir3 import week as _week
      
      # --- Standort (dein Ort, hier im Planfile) ----------------------------------
      # lat, lon, IANA-Zeitzone. Ohne diese Zeile bestimmt dir3 ihn per Geolocation.
      location = (40.7992, 29.4305, "Europe/Istanbul")
      
      # --- Gebete: (Name, Adhan-Anker, Rakat-Zahl) --------------------------------
      # Start je 5 Minuten vor dem Adhan; jede Rakat dauert 2 Minuten.
      SALAWAT = [
          ("Fajr", prayer.fajr, 2),
          ("Dhuhr", prayer.dhuhr, 4),
          ("Asr", prayer.asr, 4),
          ("Maghrib", prayer.maghrib, 3),
          ("Isha", prayer.isha, 4),
      ]
      
      
      def _salawat():
          return [
              task(
                  name,
                  start=adhan - timedelta(minutes=5),
                  duration=timedelta(minutes=rakats * 2),
              )
              for name, adhan, rakats in SALAWAT
          ]
      
      
      @day(name="Gebets-Tag")
      def werktag(ctx):
          fajr, dhuhr, asr, maghrib, isha = _salawat()
          return [
              fajr,
              task("Lesen", duration=timedelta(hours=2), flex=True),
              task("Frühstück", duration=timedelta(hours=1), flex=True),
              task("Coding", duration=timedelta(hours=2), flex=True),
              dhuhr,
              task("Qaylulah", duration=timedelta(minutes=40)),
              asr,
              task("Dinner", duration=timedelta(hours=1), flex=True),
              maghrib,
              isha,
              task("Schlafen", until=next_event),
          ]
      
      
      @day(name="Familien-Tag")
      def familientag(ctx):
          fajr, dhuhr, asr, maghrib, isha = _salawat()
          return [
              fajr,
              task("Rausgehen", duration=timedelta(minutes=90)),
              task("Familienzeit", duration=timedelta(hours=2)),
              task("Lesen", duration=timedelta(hours=3), flex=True),
              dhuhr,
              task("Qaylulah", duration=timedelta(minutes=40)),
              asr,
              task(
                  "Coding",
                  until=prayer.maghrib - timedelta(minutes=5),
                  flex=True,
              ),
              maghrib,
              task("Familienzeit", duration=timedelta(hours=1), flex=True),
              isha,
              task("Schlafen", until=next_event),
          ]
      
      
      def make_plan():
          return _week(
              mon=werktag,
              tue=werktag,
              wed=werktag,
              thu=werktag,
              fri=werktag,
              sat=familientag,
              sun=familientag,
          )
      
      
      # --- Google Calendar (optional) ----------------------------------------------
      # Einmalig: dir3-gcal-setup --client-id … --client-secret …  (liefert das
      # Refresh-Token), dann diesen Block hierher einfügen und mit --sync-gcal laufen:
      #
      #   dir3 examples/gebets_woche.py --sync-gcal
      #
      # from dir3 import GoogleCalendar
      # gcal = GoogleCalendar(
      #     client_id="…",
      #     client_secret="…",
      #     refresh_token="…",
      #     calendar_id="primary",
      # )
      
      
      __title__ = "Gebets-Woche"
      
      gcal = GoogleCalendar(
          client_id='251032523871-1ltlu7p65v6614oo0uee2cs6usjj3gdn.apps.googleusercontent.com',
          client_secret='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',

  content: |
      """Schlafen bis zum naechsten Event - sogar im naechsten Tag.
      
      ``until=next_event`` ist der weichste Anker der Welt: Der Schlaf-Task läuft
      genau bis zum ersten Event des naechsten A*k*tiven* Tages und endet mitten in
      das, was als Naechstes kommt - freie Tage werden uebersprungen. Kein Wecker,
      keine feste Zeit: Der Plan selbst sagt dir, wann morgen wieder Leben ist.
      
          Schlafen     23:00 – 06:00   (läuft ins Folgetag)
      
      Haengt das erste Event von morgen an einem Anker (z. B. ``prayer.fajr``),
      wird der Schlaf je nach Jahreszeit mit der Sonne kuerzer oder laenger -
      der eine Endpunkt ist nie die Uhr, sondern "das nächste Leben".
      """
      
      from datetime import time
      
      from dir3 import day, next_event, prayer, task
      from dir3 import week as _week
      
      # --- Standort (dein Ort, hier im Planfile) ----------------------------------
      # lat, lon, IANA-Zeitzone. Ohne diese Zeile bestimmt dir3 ihn per Geolocation.
      location = (40.7992, 29.4305, "Europe/Istanbul")
      
      
      @day(name="Mein Tag")
      def alltag(ctx):
          return [
              task("Fajr-Gebet", start=prayer.fajr, duration="15m"),
              task("Frühstück", start=time(7, 0), duration="30m"),
              task("Arbeit & Lernen", start=time(8, 30), until=time(17, 0), flex=True),
              task("Isha-Gebet", start=prayer.isha, duration="10m"),
              task("Familie & runterfahren", duration="1h", flex=True),
              task("Schlafen", until=next_event),
          ]
      
      
      def make_plan():
          return _week(
              mon=alltag,
              tue=alltag,
              wed=alltag,
              thu=alltag,
              fri=alltag,
              sat=alltag,
              sun=alltag,
          )
      
      
      __title__ = "Schlafen bis zum nächsten Event"

- path: examples/complete_year.py
  content: |
      """Dein ganzes Jahr ist EINE Funktion.
      
      Das ist der rote Faden: statt dutzender Kalenderbausteine "programmierst du
      dein Leben" als eine einzige (date) -> Tag Funktion. Jeder Kalendereintrag ist
      ein Code-Zweig:
      
          * Schultage           nach Wochentag;
          * Wochenende          nach Wochentag;
          * Freie Tage          durch einen einfachen Set-Ueberlauf;
          * Pruefungen          an konkreten Daten -> erscheinen automatisch;
          * Feiertage/Geburtstage -> weiche, unvergessliche Bausteine.
      
      Alles ist Python. Willst du einen neuen Feiertag? Eine neue Prüfung?
      Einfach eine Zeile ändern - das ganze Jahr passt sich neu zusammen.
      """
      from datetime import date, time
      
      from dir3 import anchor, day, task
      from dir3 import calendar as _calendar
      
      # --- Standort (dein Ort, hier im Planfile) ----------------------------------
      # lat, lon, IANA-Zeitzone. Ohne diese Zeile bestimmt dir3 ihn per Geolocation.
      location = (40.7992, 29.4305, "Europe/Istanbul")
      
      # --- Kalender-Fakten (aus den deiner Welt) ----------------------------------
      FEIERTAGE = {
          date(2026, 12, 24): "Heiligabend",
          date(2026, 1, 1): "Neujahr",
          date(2026, 3, 20): "Tuerkischer Befreiungstag",
      }
      
      PRUEFUNGEN = {
          date(2026, 3, 12): "Zwischenklausur Analysis",
          date(2026, 7, 8): "Muedliche Pruefung",
          date(2026, 8, 25): "Nachpruefung Statistik",
      }
      
      GEBURTSTAGE = {
          date(2026, 9, 15): "Aylin",
          date(2026, 12, 2): "Mama",
      }
      
      FREIE_TAGE = {date(2026, 6, 29), date(2026, 9, 21)}
      
      PA_FREI = frozenset(date(2026, m, 1) for m in range(1, 13))  # 1. des Monats
      
      
      @anchor
      def morgen(ctx):
          return time(6, 30)
      
      
      @anchor
      def pausetastisch(ctx):
          return time(12, 30)
      
      
      @day(name="Schultag")
      def schul(ctx):
          return [
              task("Frühstück & Rucksack", start=morgen, duration="30m"),
              task("Schule", start=time(8, 0), until=time(13, 0), flex=True),
              task("Hausaufgaben", start=time(15, 0), duration="1h30m", flex=True),
              task("Freizeit/Familie", duration="2h", flex=True),
          ]
      
      
      @day(name="Pa-Tag")
      def freitag(ctx):
          return [
              task("Schule bis Mittag", start=time(8, 0), until=time(12, 0), flex=True),
              task("Freitagspause", start=pausetastisch, duration="2h"),
              task("Fragen an die Familie", start=time(15, 0), duration="1h"),
              task("Abend & Familie", duration="3h", flex=True),
          ]
      
      
      @day(name="Wochenende")
      def wochenende(ctx):
          return [
              task("Ausschlafen", start=time(9, 0), duration="2h"),
              task("Familienzeit", start=time(11, 0), duration="3h", flex=True),
              task("Freizeit & Hobby", duration="2h", flex=True),
          ]
      
      
      @day(name="Prüfung")
      def pruefung(ctx):
          return [
              task("Ruhiger Kopf", start=morgen, duration="45m"),
              task("PRÜFUNG", start=time(10, 0), duration="2h", flex=False),
              task("Durchatmen & Feiern", start=pausetastisch, duration="2h"),
          ]
      
      
      def _feiertag(geben_date):
          return [
              task(anlass, start=time(11, 0), duration="2h", flex=True)
              for anlass in [FEIERTAGE.get(geben_date), GEBURTSTAGE.get(geben_date)]
              if anlass
          ]
      
      
      @_calendar
      def lebensjahr(today):
          """Eine Funktion = dein ganzes Jahr."""
          if today in PRUEFUNGEN:
              return pruefung
          if today in FREIE_TAGE:
              return None  # bewusst freier Tag
          if today in FEIERTAGE or today in GEBURTSTAGE:
              @day(name=FEIERTAGE[today] if today in FEIERTAGE else "Geburtstag")
              def fest(ctx):
                  return _feiertag(today) + [
                      task("Feiern & Geniessen", start=time(14, 0), duration="3h", flex=True),
                  ]
              return fest
          if today.weekday() >= 5:  # Sa / So
              return wochenende
          if today.weekday() == 4:  # Freitag
              return freitag
          if today.day == 1:
              @day(name="Fragen-Tag")
              def monatsanfang(ctx):
                  return [
                      task("Fragen-Block", start=morgen, duration="1h30m"),
                      task("Monatsplan bauen", start=pausetastisch, duration="1h"),
                  ]
              return monatsanfang
          return schul
      
      
      def make_plan():
          return lebensjahr
      
      
      __title__ = "Dein erstes ganzes Jahr"

  content: |
      """Fastentag: Der Tag endet nie an der Uhr, sondern an der Sonne.
      
      Alle Bausteine sind eigene Anker, die aus den Gebetszeiten abgeleitet werden.
      Aendere den Standort (per ``location = (...)`` im Planfile oder automatisch
      per Geolocation) - *der ganze Tag verschiebt sich* mit dem Sonnenlauf. Die
      Mahlzeiten richten sich nach den echten Gebetszeiten:
      
          Qiyam  ... freiwilliges Nachtgebet vor dem Morgengrauen
          imsak  ... letzte Gelegenheit zu essen (20 min vor Fajr)
          iftar  ... gebrochen wird erst beim Maghrib - die Sonne entscheidet
      """
      from datetime import time, timedelta
      
      from dir3 import anchor, day, prayer, subtract_time, task
      from dir3 import week as _week
      
      # --- Standort (dein Ort, hier im Planfile) ----------------------------------
      # lat, lon, IANA-Zeitzone. Ohne diese Zeile bestimmt dir3 ihn per Geolocation.
      location = (40.7992, 29.4305, "Europe/Istanbul")
      
      
      @anchor
      def qiyam(ctx):
          """Ruhige Nacht — kurz vor dem Morgengrauen."""
          fajr = ctx.prayer.schedule(ctx).fajr
          return subtract_time(fajr, timedelta(hours=1))
      
      
      @anchor
      def imsak(ctx):
          """Letzte Essens-Marke: 20 Minuten bevor die Sonne den Tag beginnt."""
          return subtract_time(ctx.prayer.schedule(ctx).fajr, timedelta(minutes=20))
      
      
      @anchor
      def iftar(ctx):
          """Fastenbrechen genau beim Maghrib — keine abendliche Deadline, die Sonne."""
          return ctx.prayer.schedule(ctx).maghrib
      
      
      @anchor
      def beruf_endet(ctx):
          """Der Arbeitstag endet, wenn die Sonne sinkt (in der Fastenzeit)."""
          return subtract_time(ctx.prayer.schedule(ctx).maghrib, timedelta(minutes=30))
      
      
      @day(name="Fastentag")
      def fasten(ctx):
          return [
              task("Qiyam — stille Nacht", start=qiyam, duration="20m"),
              task("Suhoor & Vorbereitung", until=imsak),
              task("Fajr-Gebet", start=prayer.fajr, duration="15m"),
              task("Koran & Reflexion", duration="30m"),
              task("Schule/Arbeit", start=time(8, 30), until=beruf_endet, flex=True),
              task("Maghrib-Gebet", start=prayer.maghrib, duration="10m"),
              task("Fastenbrechen (Iftar)", duration="40m"),
              task("Isha-Gebet", start=prayer.isha, duration="10m"),
              task("Tarawih & Gemeinschaft", duration="45m", flex=True),
          ]
      
      
      def make_plan():
          return _week(
              mon=fasten, tue=fasten, wed=fasten, thu=fasten,
              fri=fasten, sat=fasten, sun=fasten,
          )
      
      
      __title__ = "Fastentag nach dem Sonnenlauf"

- path: examples/autopilot.py
  content: |
      """Autopilot-Tag: liest Daten und plant sich selbst.
      
      Dir3 ist hier dein Assistenzsystem. Der Tag kennt:
      
      * dein Wetter-Block (ein Dict)      -> draussen oder drinnen;
      * dein Energie-Log                  -> kurze oder lange Deep-Work-Session;
      * die Oeffnungszeiten deines Gym    -> der Sport startet, wenn es aufsperrt;
      * deine Projekt-Deadlines           -> tauchen automatisch als Countdown auf.
      
      Aendere einen einzigen Wert weiter unten und der ganze Tag reagiert.
      """
      from datetime import date, time
      
      from dir3 import anchor, day, task
      
      # --- Standort (dein Ort, hier im Planfile) ----------------------------------
      # lat, lon, IANA-Zeitzone. Ohne diese Zeile bestimmt dir3 ihn per Geolocation.
      location = (40.7992, 29.4305, "Europe/Istanbul")
      
      # --- deine Daten (aendere einfach die Werte) -------------------------------
      # Wetter pro Tag ("regen"/"sonnig"); unbekannte Tage gelten als "sonnig".
      WETTER = {
          "2026-09-21": "regen",
          "2026-09-22": "regen",
          "2026-09-23": "sonnig",
      }
      
      # Energie-Log pro Tag des Monats (1=eher leer ... 3=voll). Fehlt ein Tag -> 3.
      ENERGIE = {9: 1, 10: 2}
      
      # Oeffnungszeiten des Gym pro Wochentag (Python: Montag=0 ... Sonntag=6).
      GYM_ZEITEN = {
          0: (6, 22), 1: (6, 22), 2: (6, 22), 3: (6, 22), 4: (6, 22),
          5: (8, 14), 6: (8, 16),
      }
      
      # Projekt-Deadlines; der Plan zeigt automatisch den Countdown.
      DEADLINES = [
          ("2026-09-25", "Thesis Kapitel 3"),
          ("2026-10-02", "Foliensatz Praesi"),
      ]
      
      
      def regnet(ctx) -> bool:
          return WETTER.get(ctx.date.isoformat(), "sonnig") == "regen"
      
      
      def energie_leer(ctx) -> bool:
          return ENERGIE.get(ctx.date.day, 3) <= 1
      
      
      def gym_offen_um_sechs(ctx) -> bool:
          auf, zu = GYM_ZEITEN[ctx.date.weekday()]
          return auf <= 6 < zu
      
      
      @anchor
      def gym_oeffnet(ctx):
          """Eigenes Anker: das Gym öffnet (datengetrieben)."""
          hour = GYM_ZEITEN[ctx.date.weekday()][0]
          return time(hour, 0)
      
      
      def _deadline_tasks(ctx):
          """Nahende Fristen tauchen einfach im Tagesplan auf."""
          nahende = []
          for iso, name in DEADLINES:
              rest = (date.fromisoformat(iso) - ctx.date).days
              if 0 <= rest <= 3:
                  label = "HEUTE faellig" if rest == 0 else f"noch {rest} Tage"
                  nahende.append(task(f"[Frist] {name} ({label})", duration="1h", flex=True))
          return nahende
      
      
      @day(name="Autopilot-Tag")
      def autopilot(ctx):
          lots = [
              # Der Sport startet, sobald dein Studio wirklich offen ist.
              task(
                  "Fitness im Studio",
                  start=gym_oeffnet,
                  duration="45m",
                  flex=True,
                  unless=(lambda ctx: not gym_offen_um_sechs(ctx)),
              ),
              task("Morgenroutine & Duschen", start=time(6, 45), duration="45m"),
              # Deep Work skaliert mit deiner Energie von heute.
              task(
                  "Deep Work",
                  start=time(8, 0),
                  duration="1h" if energie_leer(ctx) else "3h",
                  flex=True,
              ),
              task("Pause & Herzlich", duration="15m", flex=False),
              task("Post & Kram", duration="45m", flex=True),
              task("Mittag", start=time(12, 30), duration="45m"),
          ]
          # Das Wetter entscheidet zwischen draußen und drinnen.
          if regnet(ctx):
              lots.append(task("Drinnen: Bücher & Tee", start=time(19, 0), duration="1h"))
          else:
              lots.append(task("Draußen: Radrunde", start=time(19, 0), duration="1h"))
          lots.extend(_deadline_tasks(ctx))
          return lots
      
      
      def make_plan():
          from dir3 import week as _week
      
          return _week(mon=autopilot, tue=autopilot, wed=autopilot, thu=autopilot,
                       fri=autopilot, sat=autopilot, sun=autopilot)
      
      
      __title__ = "Autopilot: Dein Tag kennt deine Daten"

      """Workday template: deep work between prayer, dissolves on holidays.
      
      The heavy blocks carry ``unless=is_holiday`` so they simply disappear on a
      legal holiday (the free slots stay light).  Drive the whole day with a
      calendar instead - ``public_holidays_week.py`` - or force a single day:
      
          @day
          def monday(ctx):
              return workday(ctx)
      """
      from datetime import time
      
      from dir3 import day, next_event, prayer, sun, task
      
      from .public_holidays import is_holiday
      
      
      @day(name="Workday")
      def workday(ctx):
          return [
              task("Fajr", start=prayer.fajr, duration="15m"),
              task("Morning routine", duration="45m"),
              task("Commute to office", duration="45m"),
              task("Deep work", until=time(12, 0), flex=True, unless=is_holiday),
              task("Dhuhr & lunch", start=prayer.dhuhr, duration="1h"),
              task("Afternoon work", duration="1h45m", flex=True, unless=is_holiday),
              task("Asr & coffee", start=prayer.asr, duration="30m", unless=is_holiday),
              task("Wrap up & emails", duration="45m", flex=True, unless=is_holiday),
              task("Commute home", duration="45m"),
              task("Dinner with family", start=prayer.maghrib, duration="1h"),
              task("Evening reading", duration="1h", flex=True),
              task("Sleep", until=next_event),
          ]
      
      
      @day(name="Weekend")
      def weekend(ctx):
          return [
              task("Slow morning", start=sun.sunrise, duration="1h30m"),
              task("Market & errands", start=time(10, 0), duration="1h30m", flex=True),
              task("Lunch", start=prayer.dhuhr, duration="45m"),

      """Ein Tag, der sich an den Gebetszeiten ausrichtet - der munazzim-Fall.
      
      `ctx.prayer` liefert pro Kalendertag frische Anker (fajr, sunrise, dhuhr,
      asr, maghrib, isha); davon lassen sich mit `- timedelta(...)` abgeleitete
      Anker bauen. Alles wird pro Tag lazy aufgelöst.
      """
      from datetime import time, timedelta
      
      from dir3 import day as _day
      from dir3 import next_day_start, task, week
      
      # --- Standort (dein Ort, hier im Planfile) ----------------------------------
      # lat, lon, IANA-Zeitzone. Ohne diese Zeile bestimmt dir3 ihn per Geolocation.
      location = (40.7992, 29.4305, "Europe/Istanbul")
      
      
      @_day(name="Gebets-Tag")
      def day(ctx):
          p = ctx.prayer
          return [
              task("Read", start=time(4, 0), until=p.sunrise - timedelta(minutes=30)),
              task("Fajr", until=p.sunrise),
              task("Arabic Shi'r", duration=timedelta(minutes=51)),
              task("Breakfast", duration=timedelta(hours=1)),
              task("Read", until=p.dhuhr - timedelta(minutes=10)),
              task("Dhuhr", until=p.dhuhr + timedelta(minutes=30)),
              task("Research", space=timedelta(hours=1), until=p.asr - timedelta(minutes=10)),
              task("Asr", until=p.asr + timedelta(minutes=20)),
              task("Eat Food", duration=timedelta(hours=1, minutes=30)),
              task("Family Time", until=p.maghrib - timedelta(minutes=10)),
              task("Maghrib", until=p.maghrib + timedelta(minutes=20)),
              task("Isha", start=p.isha - timedelta(minutes=10), until=p.isha + timedelta(minutes=30)),
              task("Sleep", until=next_day_start),
          ]
      
      
      def make_plan():
          """Rufe es direkt auf: `dir3 examples/templates/pray_based_home_routine.py --until 1`."""
          return week(mon=day, tue=day, wed=day, thu=day, fri=day, sat=day, sun=day)

      """Google Calendar sync via aiogoogle (async).
      
      Der Sync schiebt einen kompilierten :class:`Plan` als Events in Google
      Calendar.  Credentials liegen im Python-Planfile (``gcal = GoogleCalendar(...)``)
      - gleiche Philosophie wie der Rest von dir3.
      
      Idempotenz: jedes Event bekommt eine deterministische Custom-ID (plain
      SHA1-Hex über Titel/Tag/Name/Zeiten).  Die ID steht im Insert-Body
      (base32hex-konform), also meldet ein erneuter Lauf desselben Plans ``409``
      und aktualisiert (PUT) statt zu duplizieren.
      
      Parallelitaet: Jeder Tag bekommt seine eigene Upload-Task - alle Tage laufen
      gleichzeitig (``asyncio.gather``), begrenzt durch ``max_parallel_days``.
      Innerhalb eines Tages fliegen Inserts/Updates als aiogoogle-Batches
      (``as_user(*requests)``, max. ``BATCH_SIZE`` pro Batch) gleichzeitig raus.
      
      Auth (OAuth2, via aiogoogle):
        * ``refresh_token`` + ``client_id``/``client_secret`` -> automatischer
          Refresh beim ersten Request des Laufs;
        * oder ein bereits ausgestelltes ``access_token`` wird direkt benutzt.
      """
      from __future__ import annotations
      
      import asyncio
      import hashlib
      from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Callable
      from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
      from dataclasses import dataclass
      from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
      
      from aiogoogle import Aiogoogle
      from aiogoogle.auth.creds import ClientCreds, UserCreds
      
      from ..color import ColorPolicy, DefaultIconPolicy, PrayerColorPolicy, to_gcal_color_id
      from ..config import GoogleCalendar
      from .geo import _resolve_tz
      
      #: Minimaler Umfang - dir3 legt nur Events an/aktualisiert sie, liest nie.
      SCOPES = ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events"]
      
      #: Direkt gegebenes Access-Token gilt für den (kurzen) Sync-Lauf als frisch,
      #: damit aiogoogle keinen Refresh ohne Refresh-Token versucht.
      _ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL = timedelta(hours=1)
      
      
      @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
      class StagedEvent:
          event_id: str
          summary: str
          body: dict[str, object]
          when: str
          day: str = ""
      
      
      @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
      class GCalSyncReport:
          total: int
          created: int
          updated: int
          dry_run: bool
      
          def __str__(self) -> str:
              verb = "geplant" if self.dry_run else "synchronisiert"
              noun = "Event" if self.total == 1 else "Events"
              parts = [f"GCal: {self.total} {noun} {verb}"]
              if not self.dry_run:
                  parts.append(f"{self.created} neu, {self.updated} aktualisiert")
              return " · ".join(parts)
      
      
      @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
      class GCalClearReport:
          deleted: int
          dry_run: bool
      
          def __str__(self) -> str:
              noun = "Event" if self.deleted == 1 else "Events"
              if self.dry_run:
                  return f"GCal: wuerde {self.deleted} {noun} loeschen"
              return f"GCal: {self.deleted} {noun} geloescht"
      
      
      def _creds_for(settings: GoogleCalendar) -> tuple[UserCreds, ClientCreds | None]:
          """aiogoogle-Credentials aus den Planfile-Einstellungen bauen."""
          if settings.access_token:
              user_creds = UserCreds(
                  access_token=settings.access_token,
                  expires_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc) + _ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL,
              )
              return user_creds, None
          user_creds = UserCreds(refresh_token=settings.refresh_token)
          client_creds = ClientCreds(
              client_id=settings.client_id,
              client_secret=settings.client_secret,
              scopes=list(SCOPES),
          )
          return user_creds, client_creds
      
      
      @asynccontextmanager
      async def _open_client(
          settings: GoogleCalendar, timeout: float
      ) -> AsyncIterator[tuple[Aiogoogle, object]]:
          """Echte aiogoogle-Verbindung: Session + entdeckte Calendar-API liefern."""
          user_creds, client_creds = _creds_for(settings)
          async with Aiogoogle(user_creds=user_creds, client_creds=client_creds) as google:
              yield google, await google.discover("calendar", "v3")
      
      
      #: Öffnet ``(aiogoogle, calendar_api)`` - in Tests durch einen Fake ersetzbar.
      ClientFactory = Callable[[GoogleCalendar, float], object]
      
      #: Max. Events pro aiogoogle-Batch - ein Batch fliegt parallel raus
      #: (``as_user(*requests)``), Batches laufen nacheinander (API-Hoeflichkeit).
      BATCH_SIZE = 11
      
      #: Status, die einen Retry mit Backoff verdienen (Rate-Limits / flaky Server).
      _RETRYABLE_STATUS = {429, 500, 502, 503, 504}
      
      #: Retry-Versuche pro Batch + Start-Delay (verdoppelt sich pro Versuch).
      _MAX_TRIES = 4
      _RETRY_BASE_DELAY = 2.0
      
      
      def _is_rate_limited(res) -> bool:
          """True bei 403ern mit Rate-Limit-Grund (kein Auth-Problem)."""
          payload = getattr(res, "json", None) or {}
          if isinstance(payload, dict):
              error = payload.get("error") or {}
              details = error.get("errors") or []
              for detail in details:
                  if not isinstance(detail, dict):
                      continue
                  if "ratelimit" in str(detail.get("reason", "")).lower():
                      return True
              message = str(error.get("message", "")).lower()
              if "rate limit" in message or "ratelimit" in message:
                  return True
          text = str(getattr(res, "data", "") or "").lower()
          return "rate limit" in text or "ratelimit" in text
      
      
      def _response_kind(res) -> str:
          """``ok`` | ``conflict`` (409) | ``gone`` (404/410) | ``retry`` | ``fatal``."""
          code = res.status_code
          if 200 <= code < 300:
              return "ok"
          if code == 409:
              return "conflict"
          if code in (404, 410):
              return "gone"
          if code in _RETRYABLE_STATUS or (code == 403 and _is_rate_limited(res)):
              return "retry"
          return "fatal"
      
      
      async def _send_requests(google, pairs, *, timeout) -> list:
          """``(item, request)``-Batch senden, mit Retry bei Rate-Limits.
      
          Gibt fertige ``(item, response)``-Paare zurück (409/404/410 sind normale
          Outcomes, kein Retry); fatale Fehler raisen via ``res.raise_for_status()``.
          """
          pending = list(pairs)
          if not pending:
              return []
          finished = []
          delay = _RETRY_BASE_DELAY
          for attempt in range(_MAX_TRIES):
              last = attempt == _MAX_TRIES - 1
              responses = await google.as_user(
                  *(req for _, req in pending),
                  timeout=timeout,
                  full_res=True,
                  raise_for_status=False,
              )
              if not isinstance(responses, list):
                  responses = [responses]
              still = []
              for (item, _req), res in zip(pending, responses):
                  kind = _response_kind(res)
                  if kind == "retry" and not last:
                      still.append((item, _req))
                  elif kind == "fatal" or kind == "retry":
                      res.raise_for_status()
                  else:
                      finished.append((item, res))
              pending = still
              if not pending:
                  return finished
              await asyncio.sleep(delay)
              delay *= 2
          raise AssertionError("unerreichbar - letzter Versuch raist oder beendet immer")
      
      
      def _chunks(items: list, size: int):
          for index in range(0, len(items), size):
              yield items[index : index + size]
      
      
      class GoogleCalendarSyncer:
          def __init__(
              self,
              settings: GoogleCalendar,
              *,
              client_factory: ClientFactory | None = None,
              timeout: float = 10.0,
              max_parallel_days: int = 8,
              color_policy: ColorPolicy | None = None,
              icon_policy: object | None = None,
          ) -> None:
              self.settings = settings
              self._client_factory = client_factory or _open_client
              self.timeout = timeout
              self.max_parallel_days = max_parallel_days
              self._color_policy = color_policy or PrayerColorPolicy()
              self._icon_policy = icon_policy or DefaultIconPolicy()
              self._position = 0  # Für die Position im Event-Stack
      
          def stage(self, plan, *, timezone_name: str) -> list[StagedEvent]:
              """Alle aktiven Events als GCal-Payloads aufbauen (rein, kein Netzwerk).
      
              Der Engine arbeitet in Plan-Wanduhrzeit (naive datetimes); hier wird die
              Plan-Zeitzone attachiert, damit GCal absolute Zeitpunkte bekommt.
              """
              tz = _resolve_tz(timezone_name or "UTC")
              tz_label = getattr(tz, "key", None) or "UTC"
              staged: list[StagedEvent] = []
              for day_ in plan.days:
                  if not day_.active:
                      continue
                  position = 0
                  for ev in day_.events:
                      if not ev.active:
                          continue
                      start = _aware(ev.start, tz)
                      end = _aware(ev.end, tz)
                      fingerprint = "|".join(
                          (plan.title, day_.date.isoformat(), ev.name, start.isoformat(), end.isoformat())
                      )
                      event_id = hashlib.sha1(fingerprint.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
                      # Event-Zusammenfassung: gekürzter Name + Icon aus der IconPolicy
                      # Event-Zusammenfassung: gekürzter Name + Icon aus der IconPolicy
                      body_summary = event_summary(ev.name, self._icon_policy, self._position)
                      self._position += 1
                      body = {
                          "id": event_id,
                          "summary": body_summary,
                          "start": {"dateTime": start.isoformat(), "timeZone": tz_label},
                          "end": {"dateTime": end.isoformat(), "timeZone": tz_label},
                          "description": f"dir3 · {plan.title}",
                          "extendedProperties": {"private": {"dir3": "1"}},
                      }
                      color_id = to_gcal_color_id(self._color_policy.color_for(ev.name, position))
                      if color_id is not None:
                          body["colorId"] = color_id
                      position += 1
      
                      staged.append(
                          StagedEvent(
                              event_id=event_id,
                              summary=body_summary,
                              body=body,
                              when=start.isoformat(),
                              day=day_.date.isoformat(),
                          )
                      )
              staged.sort(key=lambda event: event.when)
              return staged
      
          async def sync(
              self,
              plan,
              *,
              timezone_name: str,
              dry_run: bool = False,
          ) -> GCalSyncReport:
              staged = self.stage(plan, timezone_name=timezone_name)
              if dry_run or not staged:
                  return GCalSyncReport(total=len(staged), created=0, updated=0, dry_run=dry_run)
      
              calendar_id = self.settings.calendar_id
              by_day: dict[str, list[StagedEvent]] = {}
              for event in staged:
                  by_day.setdefault(event.day, []).append(event)
      
              semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max(1, self.max_parallel_days))
              results: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
              async with self._client_factory(self.settings, self.timeout) as (google, calendar):
      
                  async def run_day(day_events: list[StagedEvent]) -> tuple[int, int]:
                      async with semaphore:
                          made, changed = 0, 0
                          for chunk in _chunks(day_events, BATCH_SIZE):
                              pairs = [
                                  (
                                      event,
                                      calendar.events.insert(
                                          calendarId=calendar_id, json=dict(event.body)
                                      ),
                                  )
                                  for event in chunk
                              ]
                              pending = []
                              for event, res in await _send_requests(
                                  google, pairs, timeout=self.timeout
                              ):
                                  if _response_kind(res) == "conflict":
                                      pending.append(event)
                                  else:
                                      made += 1
                              if pending:
                                  updates = [
                                      (
                                          event,
                                          calendar.events.update(
                                              calendarId=calendar_id,
                                              eventId=event.event_id,
                                              json=dict(event.body),
                                          ),
                                      )
                                      for event in pending
                                  ]
                                  changed += len(
                                      await _send_requests(google, updates, timeout=self.timeout)
                                  )
                          return made, changed
      
                  results = list(
                      await asyncio.gather(*(run_day(events) for events in by_day.values()))
                  )
              created = sum(made for made, _ in results)
              updated = sum(changed for _, changed in results)
              return GCalSyncReport(total=len(staged), created=created, updated=updated, dry_run=False)
      
          async def _list_ids(self, extra_params: dict) -> list[str]:
              """Event-IDs seitenweise einsammeln (Masters - direkt loeschbar)."""
              calendar_id = self.settings.calendar_id
              ids: list[str] = []
              page_token = None
              async with self._client_factory(self.settings, self.timeout) as (google, calendar):
                  while True:
                      params = {
                          "calendarId": calendar_id,
                          "maxResults": 2500,
                          "fields": "nextPageToken,items(id)",
                      }
                      params.update(extra_params)
                      if page_token:
                          params["pageToken"] = page_token
                      data = await google.as_user(
                          calendar.events.list(**params), timeout=self.timeout
                      )
                      ids.extend(item["id"] for item in data.get("items", []) if item.get("id"))
                      page_token = data.get("nextPageToken")
                      if not page_token:
                          return ids
      
          async def list_dir3_event_ids(self) -> list[str]:
              """Alle Events, die dir3 angelegt hat (Marker ``private.dir3=1``)."""
              return await self._list_ids(
                  {"singleEvents": True, "privateExtendedProperty": "dir3=1"}
              )
      
          async def list_all_event_ids(self) -> list[str]:
              """Alle Event-IDs im Kalender (fremde inklusive) - für ``--nuke``."""
              return await self._list_ids({})
      
          async def clear(self, *, dry_run: bool = False, nuke: bool = False) -> GCalClearReport:
              if nuke:
                  ids = await self.list_all_event_ids()
              else:
                  ids = await self.list_dir3_event_ids()
              if dry_run or not ids:
                  return GCalClearReport(deleted=len(ids), dry_run=dry_run)
              calendar_id = self.settings.calendar_id
              deleted = 0
              async with self._client_factory(self.settings, self.timeout) as (google, calendar):
                  for chunk in _chunks(ids, BATCH_SIZE):
                      pairs = [
                          (
                              event_id,
                              calendar.events.delete(calendarId=calendar_id, eventId=event_id),
                          )
                          for event_id in chunk
                      ]
                      # ok + gone (404/410, schon weg) zählen als erledigt
                      deleted += len(await _send_requests(google, pairs, timeout=self.timeout))
              return GCalClearReport(deleted=deleted, dry_run=False)
      
      
      def run_sync(syncer: GoogleCalendarSyncer, plan, *, timezone_name: str, dry_run: bool = False):
          """Sync-Wrapper für den synchronen CLI-Pfad."""
          return asyncio.run(syncer.sync(plan, timezone_name=timezone_name, dry_run=dry_run))
      
      
      def run_clear(syncer: GoogleCalendarSyncer, *, dry_run: bool = False, nuke: bool = False):
          """Clear-Wrapper für den synchronen CLI-Pfad."""
          return asyncio.run(syncer.clear(dry_run=dry_run, nuke=nuke))
      
      
      def _aware(dt, tz):
          return dt.astimezone(tz) if dt.tzinfo is not None else dt.replace(tzinfo=tz)

- path: src/dir3/color.py
  content: |
      """Event colors as a trait-like policy, portable across providers.
      
      Munazzim colors prayers fixed and cycles everything else (TUI-only there).
      dir3 ports the *idea* to real calendar colors: a :class:`ColorPolicy` decides
      *which* color family an event gets (as a neutral slot ``0..10``), each
      provider renders the slot its own way (GCal: ``colorId`` ``"1".."11"``).
      
      Rules (munazzim-inspired): the default policy keeps prayers yellow; the
      optional status policy colors prayers at the Adhan green, shifted prayers
      yellow, prayers that take lecture time orange, and critical prayers red.
      Every other event gets a deterministic color from its name - same name, same
      color.
      
      Implement the trait for custom behavior - any object with
      ``color_for(name, index) -> int | None`` works, no inheritance needed::
      
          class MyColors:
              def color_for(self, name, index):
                  return 10 if "sleep" in name.lower() else None
      """
      from __future__ import annotations
      
      from dataclasses import dataclass, field
      from typing import Protocol, runtime_checkable
      
      
      @runtime_checkable
      class ColorPolicy(Protocol):
          """Trait: maps an event to a color slot ``0..10``, or ``None`` for default."""
      
          def color_for(self, name: str, index: int) -> int | None:
              """Slot for the event with this name at this (per-day) position."""
              ...  # pragma: no cover - trait
      
      
      #: Slot -> GCal ``colorId``. Hand-picked so prayers read naturally
      #: (dawn grape, midday banana, sunset tomato, night blueberry).
      PALETTE = ("3", "6", "5", "7", "11", "9", "1", "2", "4", "8", "10")
      
      #: Normalized prayer names - always rendered yellow (GCal Banana).
      # lange Gebetsnamen -> kurze, informative Varianten für die Anzeige
      SHORT_PRAYER_NAMES: dict[str, str] = {
          "fajr": "Fajr",
          "sunrise": "Sonnenaufgang",
          "dhuhr": "Dhuhr",
          "duhr": "Dhuhr",
          "jumuah": "Jumuah",
          "asr": "Asr",
          "maghrib": "Maghrib",
          "isha": "Isha",
          "sunset": "Sonnenuntergang",
      }
      
      PRAYER_NAMES = frozenset(
          {"fajr", "sunrise", "dhuhr", "duhr", "jumuah", "asr", "maghrib", "isha"}
      )
      
      #: Slot rendering as yellow (GCal Banana ``"5"``) on every provider.
      YELLOW_SLOT = 2
      
      #: Slot rendering as green (GCal Sage ``"2"``) on every provider.
      GREEN_SLOT = 7
      
      #: Slot rendering as red (GCal Tomato ``"11"``) on every provider.
      RED_SLOT = 4
      
      #: Slot rendering as orange (GCal Tangerine ``"6"``) on every provider.
      ORANGE_SLOT = 1
      
      #: Markers a plan can put into a prayer name to describe its schedule state.
      SHIFTED_MARKER = "verschoben"
      CRITICAL_MARKER = "kritisch"
      KERAHAT_MARKER = "kerahat"
      ORANGE_MARKER = "von der vorlesung"
      
      
      def shorten_event_name(name: str | None) -> str:
          """Kürzt lange Event-Namen, ohne Information zu verlieren.
      
          Entfernt:
          - überflüssige Beschreibungen in Klammern, wenn der Kontext klar ist
          - wiederholte Präfixe wie "Weg: " wenn bereits am Anfang
          - redundante Zusätze wie "(Moschee, nur Fardh)" → "(Moschee)"
          - Indexnummern bei Vorlesungen, wenn sie länger als nötig sind
          - verbose Reiseroute-Beschreibungen zu "Weg: A >> B"
      
          Behält aber alle wichtigen Informationen bei: Adhan-Zeiten, Verschiebungen,
          Kerahat-Status, Vorlesungs-Überschneidungen, Fardh/Hadith-Info etc.
          """
          if not name:
              return ""
      
          text = str(name)
          normalized = normalize_event_name(text)
          head, sep, rest = normalized.partition(" ")
      
          # LANGE Vorlesungsnamen kürzen: "EN 732 ROBS (Uebung, Marvin)" → "EN732 ROBS (Ü)"
          # Hinweis: Nur Namen mit Kursnummer-Muster (ABC 123 XYZ) werden gekürzt.
          # Namen wie "HE101 AnalinA (Winkert)" bleiben unverändert.
          if rest.startswith("(") or any(k in rest for k in ("uebung", "übung", "exercise", "exercises", "lab", "labs", "lecture", "lectures", "seminar", "vorlesung")):
              import re
      
              # Kursnummer + Name + Klammerinfo kompaktieren (nur bei Klammer-Inhalten)
              # Pattern: ABC 123 XYZ (Info) → ABC123 XYZ (Info)
              # Hinweis: Das Pattern erlaubt Leerzeichen zwischen Prefix, Nummer und Name
              if rest.startswith("("):
                  match = re.match(r"^([a-z]+)\s*(\d+)\s*([a-z0-9]+)\s*\(([^)]+)\)$", text, re.IGNORECASE)
                  if match:
                      prefix, nummer, name_kurz, info = match.groups()
                      info_lower = info.lower()
                      if "uebung" in info_lower or "übung" in info_lower:
                          info = "Ü"
                      elif "exercise" in info_lower or "exercises" in info_lower:
                          info = "Ex"
                      elif "lab" in info_lower or "labs" in info_lower:
                          info = "Lab"
                      elif "lecture" in info_lower or "lectures" in info_lower:
                          info = "V"
                      elif "seminar" in info_lower:
                          info = "S"
                      elif "vorlesung" in info_lower:
                          info = "V"
                      return f"{prefix}{nummer} {name_kurz} ({info})".strip()
                  # Wenn Pattern nicht passt (z.B. wegen Leerzeichen), gib den Originaltext zurück
                  return text
              # Fallback: Keine Klammer, also unverändert zurückgeben
              return text
      
          # Weg-Namen kompaktieren: "Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin, Galenstr. BUS 136" → "Weg: Mertensstr. >> Berlin"
          if head == "weg" and ">>" in text:
              import re
      
              match = re.match(r"^Weg:\s*(.+?)\s*>>\s*(.+?),?\s*(?:[A-Z]{2,4}\s*\d+)?\s*(?:BUS\s*\d+)?\s*$", text, re.IGNORECASE)
              if match:
                  von = match.group(1).strip()
                  nach = match.group(2).strip()
                  return f"Weg: {von} >> {nach}"
              # Falls das Muster nicht passt (z.B. weil BUS 136 fehlt), gib den Originalnamen zurück
              return text
      
          # Redundante Klammer-Inhalte entfernen
          # Hinweis: "(Moschee)" bleibt als Marker erhalten, da es wichtige Info ist.
          # Nur spezifische redundanten Infos wie "(Moschee, nur Fardh)" werden gekürzt.
          if rest.startswith("("):
              import re
      
              text = re.sub(
                  r"\((\s*)(Moschee|NahMoschee|allein)(,\s*(nur Fardh|nur Hadith|Fardh|Hadith))?(\s*)\)",
                  lambda m: f"({'Moschee' if 'moschee' in m.group(1).lower() or 'nahmoschee' in m.group(1).lower() else 'allein'})",
                  text,
                  flags=re.IGNORECASE,
              )
              # "Fajr (Moschee)" bleibt unverändert, da es kein redundantes Info ist.
      
          return text
      
      
      def event_summary(name: str | None, icon_policy: object | None = None, index: int = 0) -> str:
          """Event-Name mit Icon und gekürztem Text für die Anzeige.
      
          Kombiniert:
          - :func:`shorten_event_name` für die Namensverkürzung
          - :meth:`icon_policy.icon_for` für das Icon (wenn vorhanden)
          
          Rückgabe: ``"🕋 Fajr"`` oder ``"🏫 EN732 ROBS (Ü)"`` etc.
          """
          if not name:
              return ""
      
          short = shorten_event_name(name)
          icon = ""
          if icon_policy is not None:
              icon_fn = getattr(icon_policy, "icon_for", None)
              if callable(icon_fn):
                  icon = icon_fn(name, index) or ""
      
          if icon:
              return f"{icon} {short}"
          return short
      
      
      def normalize_event_name(name: object) -> str:
          return str(name or "").strip().casefold()
      
      
      def name_slot(name: object) -> int:
          """Deterministic color slot from the event name.
      
          The name's bytes are summed as numbers, modulo the palette length -
          so the same name always yields the same slot on every provider::
      
              sum(b"coding") % 11 == 1
          """
          total = sum(normalize_event_name(name).encode("utf-8"))
          return total % len(PALETTE)
      
      
      def to_gcal_color_id(slot: object) -> str | None:
          """Render a policy slot as a GCal ``colorId`` (``None`` = calendar default)."""
          try:
              index = int(slot)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
          except (TypeError, ValueError):
              return None
          if isinstance(slot, bool) or not 0 <= index <= 10:
              return None
          return PALETTE[index]
      
      
      def _slot_from_color_id(value: object) -> int | None:
          """User-facing GCal ``colorId`` (``1``..``11``) -> palette slot (round-trip safe)."""
          if isinstance(value, bool):
              return None
          try:
              text = str(int(str(value).strip()))
          except (TypeError, ValueError):
              return None
          try:
              return PALETTE.index(text)
          except ValueError:
              return None
      
      
      @dataclass
      class PrayerColorPolicy:
          """Default trait impl: prayers yellow, everything else name-hashed."""

          Verschoben im Moschee → Pistazie
          Am Adhan allein → Avokado
          Verschoben allein → Zitrone
          Im Kerahat → Mandarine
          Kritisch → Tomate
      
          Alles andere fällt auf den Namen-hash zurück.
      
          Das ist dasselbe Logik wie :class:`PrayerStatusColorPolicy`, nur mit
          anderen Slot-Nummern, die auf die gewünschten GCal-Farben abbilden.
          """

          _pistazie: int = 10   # Pistazie
          _avokado: int = 3     # Avokado
          _zitrone: int = 1     # Zitrone
          _mandarine: int = 5   # Mandarine
          _tomate: int = 4      # Tomate

              if CRITICAL_MARKER in marker_text:
                  return self._tomate
      
              if ORANGE_MARKER in marker_text:
                  return self._avokado  # Am Adhan allein + Vorlesungs-Überlap

                  if "moschee" in marker_text or head == "jumuah":
                      return self._pistazie

              # Standard: Am Adhan allein

      def _load_module(path: Path, *, name: str = "dir3_planfile", seed=None, what="Planfile"):
          spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
          if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
              raise SystemExit(f"Kann {what} nicht laden: {path}")
          module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
          if seed:
              for key, value in seed.items():
                  module.__dict__.setdefault(key, value)
          sys.path.insert(0, str(path.resolve().parent))
          try:
              spec.loader.exec_module(module)
          except Exception:
              traceback.print_exc()
              raise SystemExit(f"Fehler beim Laden ({what}).")
          return module

      """Planfile-Konfiguration - alle Daten leben im Python-Planfile, keine TOML-Dateien.
      
      dir3 liest die Einstellungen direkt aus dem Planfile (analog zu ``day``/``week``):
      kein ``config.toml`` wie bei munazzim. Optional können im Planfile stehen::
      
          # 1) Standort: Tupel (lat, lon, IANA-Zeitzone) - alternativ LocationSettings/Dict
          location = (40.7992, 29.4305, "Europe/Istanbul")
      
          # 2) Gebetsberechnung (Caelestia/Salat): Methode/Schule oder Dict
          prayer = {"method": 13, "school": 0}  # Türkei/Diyanet, Shafi
          #    provider: "auto" (Aladhan + offline fallback) | "offline"
          #    method: Aladhan-ID (int), school: 0=Shafi, 1=Hanafi
          #    method_auto: True = nächste Autorität aus der live methods-Tabelle
      
          # 3) Google-Calendar-Sync (optional): Credentials im Planfile
          from dir3 import GoogleCalendar
          gcal = GoogleCalendar(
              client_id="…", client_secret="…", refresh_token="…",
              calendar_id="primary",
          )
      
      Nichts gesetzt? Dann bestimmt dir3 den Standort selbst per Geolocation
      (``ipapi.co``, funktioniert überall) und nutzt standardmäßig Aladhan mit
      offline berechneten Zeiten als Fallback. Kalender-Sync ist aus, bis das
      Planfile ``gcal = GoogleCalendar(...)`` setzt.
      """
      from __future__ import annotations
      
      import re
      from dataclasses import dataclass, field
      from pathlib import Path
      
      DEFAULT_CACHE_DIR = Path.home() / ".cache" / "dir3"
      
      
      @dataclass(slots=True)
      class LocationSettings:
          city: str = ""
          country: str = ""
          latitude: float | None = None
          longitude: float | None = None
          timezone: str | None = None
          use_geolocation: bool = True
      
      
      @dataclass(slots=True)
      class PrayerSettings:
          """Caelestia/Salat-compatible prayer settings.
      
          Mirrors ``services/Salat.qml``: ``method`` is the Aladhan numeric id,
          ``school`` is 0=Shafi / 1=Hanafi, ``method_auto`` picks the nearest
          authority from the live ``GET /v1/methods`` table by location.
          ``provider`` only switches between ``auto`` (cache → Aladhan → offline)
          and ``offline`` (never touch the network).
          """
      
          provider: str = "auto"  # auto | offline (aladhan/online are aliases for auto)
          method: int = 13
          school: int = 0  # 0=Shafi, 1=Hanafi
          method_auto: bool = True
      
      
      #: Legacy dir3 method names → Aladhan ids. Kept only to migrate old
      #: planfiles (``prayer={"method": "MWL"}``); the calculation itself is
      #: Caelestia's (live methods table + fallback angles), not dir3's old table.
      _LEGACY_METHOD_IDS = {
          "JAFARI": 0,
          "KARACHI": 1,
          "ISNA": 2,
          "MWL": 3,
          "MAKKAH": 4,
          "EGYPT": 5,
          "TEHRAN": 7,
          "GULF": 8,
          "KUWAIT": 9,
          "QATAR": 10,
          "SINGAPORE": 11,
          "FRANCE": 12,
          "TURKEY": 13,
          "RUSSIA": 14,
          "MOONSIGHTING": 15,
          "DUBAI": 16,
          "JAKIM": 17,
          "TUNISIA": 18,
          "ALGERIA": 19,
          "KEMENAG": 20,
          "MOROCCO": 21,
          "PORTUGAL": 22,
          "JORDAN": 23,
          "CUSTOM": 99,
          "DIYANET": 13,
          "UMQ": 4,
          "UMMALQURA": 4,
          "UMM-AL-QURA": 4,
          "UMM AL-QURA": 4,
          "MALAYSIA": 17,
          "INDONESIA": 20,
      }
      
      
      def _normalize_method_name(value: object) -> str:
          return re.sub(r"[\s_-]+", " ", str(value or "").strip()).upper()
      
      
      def _coerce_method_id(value: object) -> int | None:
          """Legacy method value → Aladhan id, or None when not parseable."""
          if value is None:
              return None
          if isinstance(value, bool):
              return None
          if isinstance(value, int):
              return value
          if isinstance(value, float):
              return int(value)
          text = str(value).strip()
          if re.fullmatch(r"\d+", text):
              return int(text)
          return _LEGACY_METHOD_IDS.get(_normalize_method_name(text))
      
      
      def _coerce_school(value: object) -> int | None:
          if value is None:
              return None
          if isinstance(value, bool):
              return int(value)
          if isinstance(value, int):
              return 1 if value == 1 else 0
          text = str(value).strip().lower()
          if text in ("1", "hanafi"):
              return 1
          if text in ("0", "shafi", "shafii", "shafi'i"):
              return 0
          return None
      
      
      def _apply_prayer_string(settings: PrayerSettings, value: str) -> None:
          """Apply a ``prayer = "<kürzel>"`` / ``provider = "<kürzel>"`` string."""
          text = value.strip().lower()
          if text in ("auto", "online", "aladhan"):
              settings.provider = "auto"
          elif text == "offline":
              settings.provider = "offline"
          elif text in ("ezanvakti", "diyanet"):
              # EzanVakti provider was removed; Aladhan method 13 (Diyanet/Turkey)
              # is the closest offline/online equivalent.
              settings.provider = "auto"
              settings.method = 13
              settings.method_auto = False
          else:
              method_id = _coerce_method_id(value)
              if method_id is not None:
                  settings.method = method_id
                  settings.method_auto = False
              else:
                  # Unknown token: keep explicit so failures are visible, like
                  # before (old code stored it as provider verbatim).
                  settings.provider = value
      
      
      def _apply_prayer_dict(settings: PrayerSettings, values: dict) -> None:
          provider = values.get("provider", values.get("source"))
          if isinstance(provider, str):
              _apply_prayer_string(settings, provider)
          # method / method_auto
          if "method" in values and values["method"] is not None:
              method_id = _coerce_method_id(values["method"])
              if method_id is not None:
                  settings.method = method_id
                  # Explicit method disables auto unless explicitly re-enabled,
                  # mirroring Salat.methodAuto (explicit choice sets auto=false).
                  if "method_auto" not in values and "methodAuto" not in values:
                      settings.method_auto = False
          for key in ("method_auto", "methodAuto", "methodauto"):
              if key in values and values[key] is not None:
                  settings.method_auto = bool(values[key])
          # school / madhab (legacy)
          school = None
          if "school" in values:
              school = _coerce_school(values["school"])
          if school is None and "madhab" in values:
              school = _coerce_school(values["madhab"])
          if school is not None:
              settings.school = school
          # legacy provider aliases inside dict that _apply_prayer_string missed
          # (e.g. provider="diyanet" already handled above).
      
      
      @dataclass(slots=True)
      class GoogleCalendar:
          """Google-Calendar-Sync-Credentials - direkt im Python-Planfile.
      
          OAuth2-Verfahren:
            * ``refresh_token`` + ``client_id``/``client_secret`` (empfohlen) oder
            * ein bereits ausgestelltes ``access_token`` (kurzlebig, wird direkt
              verwendet ohne Refresh-Token-Endpunkt).
          ``calendar_id`` ist der Zielkalender (Standard: ``primary``).
          """
      
          client_id: str = ""
          client_secret: str = ""
          refresh_token: str = ""
          access_token: str = ""
          calendar_id: str = "primary"
      
          @property
          def is_configured(self) -> bool:
              """True wenn ein Refresh-Token-Paar oder ein direktes Access-Token vorliegt."""
              if self.access_token:
                  return True
              return bool(self.client_id and self.client_secret and self.refresh_token)
      
      
      @dataclass(slots=True)
      class Dir3Config:
          location: LocationSettings = field(default_factory=LocationSettings)
          prayer: PrayerSettings = field(default_factory=PrayerSettings)
          calendar: GoogleCalendar | None = field(default=None)
          #: Event-Name -> GCal-colorId (``1``..``11``), z. B. ``{"Coding": 9}``.
          #: Unbekannte Events fallen auf die Prayer-Standardfarbgebung zurück.
          colors: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
          #: Eigenes ColorPolicy-Objekt (``color_for(name, index)``) aus dem Planfile.
          #: Hat Vorrang vor ``colors``.
          color_policy: object | None = None
      
          @classmethod
          def from_planfile(cls, module) -> Dir3Config:
              """Baut die Konfiguration aus optionalen Planfile-Attributen.
      
              Unterstützte Attribute:
                ``location``  - (lat, lon, tz)-Tupel, LocationSettings oder Dict;
                ``prayer``    - Provider-Kürzel, PrayerSettings oder Dict;
                ``provider``  - Kurzform für ``prayer = "<kürzel>"``.
              """
              return cls().overlay(module)
      
          def overlay(self, module) -> Dir3Config:
              """Overlays only the attributes the module actually defines.
      
              Missing attributes leave current values untouched - apply the central
              config file (``--config``) first, then the planfile (which wins).
              """
              location = getattr(module, "location", None)
              if isinstance(location, LocationSettings):
                  self.location = location
              elif isinstance(location, dict):
                  self.location = LocationSettings(**location)
              elif isinstance(location, (tuple, list)) and len(location) >= 2:
                  self.location = LocationSettings(
                      latitude=location[0],
                      longitude=location[1],
                      timezone=location[2] if len(location) > 2 else None,
                      city=location[3] if len(location) > 3 else "",
                      country=location[4] if len(location) > 4 else "",
                  )
      
              prayer = getattr(module, "prayer", None)
              if isinstance(prayer, str):
                  _apply_prayer_string(self.prayer, prayer)
              elif isinstance(prayer, PrayerSettings):
                  self.prayer = prayer
              elif isinstance(prayer, dict):
                  # Filter to known fields + legacy aliases; unknown keys are
                  # ignored here and handled via _apply_prayer_dict so legacy
                  # planfiles (method="MWL", madhab="Hanafi") keep working.
                  settings = PrayerSettings(
                      provider=self.prayer.provider,
                      method=self.prayer.method,
                      school=self.prayer.school,
                      method_auto=self.prayer.method_auto,
                  )
                  _apply_prayer_dict(settings, prayer)
                  self.prayer = settings
              elif isinstance(prayer, (tuple, list)):
                  if prayer:
                      _apply_prayer_string(self.prayer, str(prayer[0]))
                      if len(prayer) > 1:
                          method_id = _coerce_method_id(prayer[1])
                          if method_id is not None:
                              self.prayer.method = method_id
                              self.prayer.method_auto = False
      
              provider = getattr(module, "provider", None)
              if isinstance(provider, str):
                  _apply_prayer_string(self.prayer, provider)
      
              calendar = getattr(module, "gcal", None)
              if calendar is None:
                  calendar = getattr(module, "google_calendar", None)
              if isinstance(calendar, GoogleCalendar):
                  self.calendar = calendar
              elif isinstance(calendar, dict):
                  self.calendar = GoogleCalendar(**calendar)
      
              colors = getattr(module, "colors", None)
              if isinstance(colors, dict):
                  merged = dict(self.colors)
                  merged.update(colors)
                  self.colors = merged
      
              color_policy = getattr(module, "color_policy", None)
              if callable(getattr(color_policy, "color_for", None)):
                  self.color_policy = color_policy
              return self

  content: |
      """Anchors - the heart of dir3.
      
      Anything that can pin a moment in the day is an :class:`Anchor`.  You may use
      the built-ins (``prayer.*``, ``sun.*``, ``midnight``, ...) or declare *your own*
      anchor simply by writing a function and decorating it::
      
          @anchor
          def work_end(ctx):
              return ctx.resolve(business.end) - OTHER_OFFSET ...
      
      An anchor resolves to ``datetime.time`` for a given plan day - or to ``None``
      if it has no meaning on that day (the scheduler then falls back to a ``duration``
      or leaves the event flexible).
      
      Anchors form a tiny algebra: ``work_end - timedelta(hours=1)`` returns a
      derived anchor, and ``time + time`` is deliberately impossible.
      """
      from __future__ import annotations
      
      from collections.abc import Callable
      from dataclasses import dataclass
      from datetime import time, timedelta
      from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
      
      if TYPE_CHECKING:  # pragma: no cover - typing only
          from .context import DayContext
      
      #: An anchor resolves to a time for a given day, or None if inactive.
      AnchorResolver = Callable[["DayContext"], time | None]
      
      
      def _plain_time(value: Any) -> time | None:
          """Coerce ``time`` values; everything else is left to the caller."""
          return value if isinstance(value, time) else None
      
      
      class Anchor:
          """Base class for every time anchor."""
      
          __slots__ = ("name",)
      
          def __init__(self, name: str | None = None) -> None:
              self.name = name
      
          def resolve(self, ctx: DayContext) -> time | None:  # pragma: no cover - abstract
              raise NotImplementedError
      
          def describe(self) -> str:
              return self.name or type(self).__name__
      
          # --- algebra ---------------------------------------------------------
          def __add__(self, other: object) -> Anchor:
              if isinstance(other, timedelta):
                  return DerivedAnchor(self, other)
              return NotImplemented
      
          def __radd__(self, other: object) -> Anchor:
              if isinstance(other, timedelta):
                  return DerivedAnchor(self, other)
              return NotImplemented
      
          def __sub__(self, other: object) -> Anchor:
              if isinstance(other, timedelta):
                  return DerivedAnchor(self, -other)
              return NotImplemented
      
          def __rsub__(self, other: object) -> Anchor:
              # timedelta - anchor has no useful meaning; keep it impossible.
              return NotImplemented
      
          def __repr__(self) -> str:  # pragma: no cover - debugging aid
              return f"{type(self).__name__}({self.describe()!r})"
      
      
      class FunctionAnchor(Anchor):
          """An anchor backed by a plain user function ``(ctx) -> time | None``."""
      
          __slots__ = ("func",)
      
          def __init__(self, func: AnchorResolver, *, name: str | None = None) -> None:
              super().__init__(name=name or getattr(func, "__name__", None) or "anchor")
              self.func = func
      
          def resolve(self, ctx: DayContext) -> time | None:
              result = self.func(ctx)
              if result is None or isinstance(result, time):
                  return result
              raise TypeError(
                  f"Anchor {self.describe()!r} returned {type(result).__name__}, expected time or None"
              )
      
      
      class FixedAnchor(Anchor):
          """A constant point in time, e.g. ``midnight`` for the plan day's end."""
      
          __slots__ = ("_time",)
      
          def __init__(self, moment: time, *, name: str | None = None) -> None:
              super().__init__(name=name)
              self._time = moment
      
          def resolve(self, ctx: DayContext) -> time | None:
              return self._time
      
      
      class NamedAnchor(Anchor):
          """An anchor resolved through the day context's services (e.g. ``prayer.fajr``).
      
          The resolver receives the context so the value is looked up once per day and
          kept deterministic through the context cache.
          """
      
          __slots__ = ("resolver",)
      
          def __init__(self, name: str, resolver: AnchorResolver) -> None:
              super().__init__(name=name)
              self.resolver = resolver
      
          def resolve(self, ctx: DayContext) -> time | None:
              return self.resolver(ctx)
      
      
      @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
      class DerivedAnchor(Anchor):
          """``base + delta`` - a shifted anchor, wrapped modulo 24h."""
      
          base: Anchor
          delta: timedelta
      
          def __post_init__(self) -> None:
              object.__setattr__(self, "name", f"{self.base.describe()} {self._sign()}")
      
          def _sign(self) -> str:
              total = int(self.delta.total_seconds())
              if total >= 0:
                  return f"+{self.delta!s}"
              return str(self.delta)
      
          def resolve(self, ctx: DayContext) -> time | None:
              base_value = ctx.resolve(self.base)
              if base_value is None:
                  return None
              from .timeutils import add_time
      
              return add_time(base_value, self.delta)
      
          def describe(self) -> str:
              return f"{self.base.describe()} {self._sign()}"
      
      
      class NextEventAnchor(Anchor):
          """``until=next_event``: the start of the next concrete event.
      
          Resolves through the day context's look-ahead handle to the start time of
          the first event of the next *active* calendar day (free days are skipped).
          Returns ``None`` when no successor exists - the task then falls back to a
          duration or stays open until the day's end.
          """
      
          __slots__ = ()
      
          def resolve(self, ctx: DayContext) -> time | None:
              handle = getattr(ctx, "_next_event_handle", None)
              if handle is None:
                  return None
              return handle.next_event_start()
      
      
      # --- registry --------------------------------------------------------------
      
      _NAMED: dict[str, Anchor] = {}
      
      
      def register(anchor_value: Anchor, name: str | None = None) -> Anchor:
          if name is not None:
              anchor_value.name = name
          if anchor_value.name:
              _NAMED[anchor_value.name] = anchor_value
          return anchor_value
      
      
      def named_anchor(name: str) -> Anchor | None:
          return _NAMED.get(name)
      
      
      def all_anchors() -> dict[str, Anchor]:
          return dict(_NAMED)
      
      
      def anchor(func: AnchorResolver | Anchor | None = None, *, name: str | None = None):
          """Declare a function as a reusable time anchor.
      
          Usable as a bare decorator or with a name override::
      
              @anchor
              def work_end(ctx): ...
      
              @anchor(name="curfew")
              def home_latest(ctx): ...
          """
          if func is None:
              return lambda f: anchor(f, name=name)
      
          if isinstance(func, Anchor):
              return register(func, name=name)
      
          if not callable(func):
              raise TypeError("anchor() expects a callable taking (ctx) -> time | None")
      
          wrapped = FunctionAnchor(func, name=name or getattr(func, "__name__", None) or "anchor")
          return register(wrapped)
      
      
      # --- builtin constant anchors ----------------------------------------------
      
      #: End of the plan day: resolves to 00:00, the compiler interprets an
      #: `until` at or before the start as wrapping to the next calendar day.
      midnight = register(FixedAnchor(time(hour=0, minute=0), name="midnight"), "midnight")
      
      #: ``until=next_event`` - the first event of the next active calendar day.
      next_event = register(NextEventAnchor(name="next_event"), "next_event")

- path: src/dir3/context.py
  content: |
      """The per-day context every user function receives.
      
      Instead of hidden global state, dir3 hands every day/anchor function a fresh
      :class:`DayContext` for the concrete plan day.  All anchor resolutions and
      service lookups funnel through the context, which caches per day - so the whole
      compilation is deterministic for a fixed date and location.
      
      Example::
      
          @day
          def workday(ctx):
              return [
                  task("Job", until=work_end - timedelta(hours=1)),
              ]
      """
      from __future__ import annotations
      
      from dataclasses import dataclass, field
      from datetime import date, time
      from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
      
      from .anchor import Anchor, FixedAnchor, FunctionAnchor, NamedAnchor, midnight
      
      if TYPE_CHECKING:  # pragma: no cover - typing only
          from .services import Services
      
      
      class PrayerGate:
          """Anchors for the five prayers (+ sunrise). Resolve through the context."""
      
          def __init__(self, services: Services) -> None:
              self._services = services
      
          def _schedule(self, ctx: DayContext):
              return self._services.prayer.get(ctx.plan_date, ctx.location)
      
          @property
          def fajr(self) -> Anchor:
              return NamedAnchor("prayer.fajr", lambda ctx: self._schedule(ctx).fajr)
      
          @property
          def sunrise(self) -> Anchor:
              return NamedAnchor("prayer.sunrise", lambda ctx: self._schedule(ctx).sunrise)
      
          @property
          def dhuhr(self) -> Anchor:
              return NamedAnchor("prayer.dhuhr", lambda ctx: self._schedule(ctx).dhuhr)
      
          @property
          def asr(self) -> Anchor:
              return NamedAnchor("prayer.asr", lambda ctx: self._schedule(ctx).asr)
      
          @property
          def maghrib(self) -> Anchor:
              return NamedAnchor("prayer.maghrib", lambda ctx: self._schedule(ctx).maghrib)
      
          @property
          def isha(self) -> Anchor:
              return NamedAnchor("prayer.isha", lambda ctx: self._schedule(ctx).isha)
      
          def schedule(self, ctx: DayContext):
              """The raw schedule for the given day (a PrayerSchedule)."""
              return self._schedule(ctx)
      
      
      class SunGate:
          """Daylight anchors (sunrise / sunset), delegated to the prayer calculator."""
      
          def __init__(self, services: Services) -> None:
              self._services = services
      
          def _times(self, ctx: DayContext):
              return self._services.sun.get(ctx.plan_date, ctx.location)
      
          @property
          def sunrise(self) -> Anchor:
              return NamedAnchor("sun.sunrise", lambda ctx: self._times(ctx).sunrise)
      
          @property
          def sunset(self) -> Anchor:
              return NamedAnchor("sun.sunset", lambda ctx: self._times(ctx).sunset)
      
      
      @dataclass(slots=True, init=False)
      class DayContext:
          plan_date: date
          services: Services
          city: str | None = None
          _resolve_cache: dict[object, time | None] = field(default_factory=dict)
          #: engine-injected look-ahead for ``until=next_event`` (see engine.py)
          _next_event_handle: object | None = None
      
          def __init__(self, plan_date: date, services: Services) -> None:
              self.plan_date = plan_date
              self.services = services
              self.city = services.location.city or None
              self._resolve_cache = {}
              self._next_event_handle = None
      
          #: convenient access to prayer anchors and the raw schedule
          @property
          def prayer(self) -> PrayerGate:
              return PrayerGate(self.services)
      
          #: convenient access to daylight anchors
          @property
          def sun(self) -> SunGate:
              return SunGate(self.services)
      
          @property
          def weather(self):
              return self.services.weather
      
          #: the resolved location for the plan day
          @property
          def location(self):
              return self.services.location
      
          #: today's plan date, mirrors ``plan_date`` for short-form access in anchors
          @property
          def date(self) -> date:
              return self.plan_date
      
          def resolve(self, value: Anchor | time | None) -> time | None:
              """Resolve an anchor (or plain time) for this day, cached."""
              if value is None:
                  return None
